莲须：专涩精；
龙骨、牡蛎：重镇收敛、固涩滑脱。
莲子：养心安神，补肾涩精，制丸药赋形
en:
METAL LOCK PILL TO SECURE THE ESSENCE
[Source] Collected Explanations of Medical Formulas
[Actions] Supports the Kidney, astringes essence and strengthens Kidney Qi
[Indication] Kidney Qi failing to secure essence
[Ingredients]
Chief: Flatstem Milkvetch Seed 5 qian
Deputy: Euryale Seed 5 qian
Assistant: Fossilized Bone 5 qian, Oyster Shell 5 qian, Lotus Stamen 3 qian
Envoy: Lotus Seed 3 liang
[How the ingredients work together]
Flatstem Milkvetch Seed supports Kidney essence and nourishes the Liver and Kidney.
Euryale Seed strengthens the Spleen and Kidney and helps secure essence.
Lotus Stamen helps retain essence.
Fossilized Bone and Oyster Shell settle and astringe to help prevent leakage.
Lotus Seed nourishes the Heart, calms the spirit, supports the Kidney and helps bind the pills.

zh_CN:
泰山磐石散
【出处】《景岳全书》
【功效】益气健脾，养血安胎
【主治】妊娠
【组成】
君：白术 二钱
臣：人参 一钱，黄芪 一钱，续断 一钱，熟地黄 一钱，当归 一钱
佐：白芍 八分，川芎 八分，黄芩 一钱，砂仁 五分
使：甘草 五分，糯米 五分
【配伍】
人参、黄芪、白术：脾胃为气血生化之源，健脾益气以固胎之本。
当归、熟地、白芍、川芎：养血和血，补益冲任。冲为血海，任主胞胎，血足则养胎。
续断：补肝肾、固冲任、安胎；肾主系胎。
黄芩：清热安胎。
砂仁：理气和胃，醒脾行滞；防补药滋腻碍胃，使气血流通，胎气安和。
炙甘草：益气和中，调和诸药；
糯米：补脾养胃，滋养胎元。
en:
MOUNT TAI ROCK-SOLID POWDER
[Source] Complete Works of Jingyue
[Actions] Supports Qi, strengthens the Spleen, nourishes blood and steadies pregnancy
[Indication] Pregnancy
[Ingredients]
Chief: White Atractylodes Rhizome 2 qian
Deputy: Ginseng Root 1 qian, Astragalus Root 1 qian, Dipsacus Root 1 qian, Prepared Rehmannia Root 1 qian, Chinese Angelica Root 1 qian
Assistant: White Peony Root 8 fen, Sichuan Lovage Rhizome 8 fen, Scutellaria Root 1 qian, Amomum Fruit 5 fen
Envoy: Licorice Root 5 fen, Glutinous Rice 5 fen
[How the ingredients work together]
Ginseng Root, Astragalus Root and White Atractylodes Rhizome strengthen the Spleen and Stomach, supporting the production of Qi and blood and a stable pregnancy.
Chinese Angelica Root, Prepared Rehmannia Root, White Peony Root and Sichuan Lovage Rhizome nourish and harmonize blood and support the Chong and Ren vessels.
Dipsacus Root supports the Liver and Kidney and the Chong and Ren vessels, helping to steady pregnancy.
Scutellaria Root clears Heat and helps steady pregnancy.
Amomum Fruit regulates Qi and harmonizes the Stomach so rich tonics do not cause stagnation.
Prepared Licorice Root supports Qi, harmonizes the middle and brings the ingredients together.
Glutinous Rice strengthens the Spleen and Stomach and nourishes the developing fetus.

zh_CN:
黄连阿胶汤
【出处】《伤寒论》
【功效】滋阴降火，交通心肾
【主治】心肾不交
【组成】
君：黄连 四钱
臣：黄芩 三钱，白芍 三钱
佐：阿胶 三钱
使：鸡子黄 一两
【配伍】
黄连：苦寒直折，清泻心火、除烦安神。
黄芩：助黄连清心泻火；
阿胶：滋阴补肾、养血填阴，滋肾阴以济心火。
白芍：敛阴和营、柔肝缓急；
鸡子黄：滋阴润燥、养心安神，入少阴交通心肾。
en:
COPTIS AND DONKEY-HIDE GELATIN DECOCTION
[Source] Treatise on Cold Damage
[Actions] Nourishes Yin, clears fire and connects Heart and Kidney functions
[Indication] Heart-Kidney disharmony
[Ingredients]
Chief: Coptis Rhizome 4 qian
Deputy: Scutellaria Root 3 qian, White Peony Root 3 qian
Assistant: Donkey-Hide Gelatin 3 qian
Envoy: Egg Yolk 1 liang
[How the ingredients work together]
Coptis Rhizome clears Heart fire, relieves restlessness and calms the spirit.
Scutellaria Root reinforces Coptis Rhizome in clearing Heart fire.
Donkey-Hide Gelatin nourishes Kidney Yin and blood to help balance Heart fire.
White Peony Root preserves Yin, harmonizes the nutritive layer and eases spasms.
Egg Yolk nourishes Yin, moistens Dryness and calms the Heart and spirit.

zh_CN:
白虎汤
【出处】《伤寒论》
【功效】清热生津，辛寒清气
【主治】气分热盛
【组成】
君：石膏 二两
臣：知母 六钱
佐：粳米 三钱
使：甘草 二钱
【配伍】
生石膏：辛甘大寒，清泻阳明气分实热，除壮热、止大汗。
知母：苦寒质润，清热泻火、滋阴生津，助石膏清润除烦止渴。
粳米、炙甘草：益气养胃、缓和石膏知母寒凉之性，保护胃气；生津补液，防大寒伤中。
en:
WHITE TIGER DECOCTION
[Source] Treatise on Cold Damage
[Actions] Clears Heat and generates body fluids, especially Heat at the Qi level
[Indication] Intense Heat at the Qi level
[Ingredients]
Chief: Gypsum 2 liang
Deputy: Anemarrhena Rhizome 6 qian
Assistant: Non-Glutinous Rice 3 qian
Envoy: Licorice Root 2 qian
[How the ingredients work together]
Raw Gypsum strongly clears intense Heat at the Yangming Qi level, easing high fever and heavy sweating.
Anemarrhena Rhizome clears Heat, nourishes Yin and generates fluids, relieving agitation and thirst.
Non-Glutinous Rice and prepared Licorice Root support Qi and the Stomach, temper the cooling herbs and protect body fluids.

zh_CN:
风寒表实证

【病机】寒邪束表、腠理闭塞、卫阳被遏。

【症状】恶寒发热，头身酸疼，无汗而喘。

【脉象】
浮脉（表）：波峰高，脉搏次数少

【标准方】麻黄汤
en:
Wind-Cold EXTERIOR EXCESS PATTERN

[Pathogenesis] Cold constrains the exterior, closes the pores and inhibits defensive Yang.

[Symptoms] Aversion to cold with fever, aching of the head and body, no sweating, and wheezing.

[Pulse]
Floating pulse (Exterior): increased amplitude, lower pulse frequency

[Standard formula] Ephedra Decoction

zh_CN:
风寒表虚证

【病机】风寒袭表，卫气不固，营阴外泄。

【症状】恶风发热，头痛流清涕，出汗。

【脉象】
浮脉（表）：波峰低，脉搏次数少

【标准方】桂枝汤
en:
Wind-Cold EXTERIOR DEFICIENCY PATTERN

[Pathogenesis] Wind-Cold invades the exterior; defensive Qi fails to secure the surface, allowing nutritive Yin to escape.

[Symptoms] Aversion to wind with fever, headache, clear nasal discharge, and sweating.

[Pulse]
Floating pulse (Exterior): decreased amplitude, lower pulse frequency

[Standard formula] Cinnamon Twig Decoction

zh_CN:
风热表证

【病机】风热之邪侵袭肺卫，卫气失和，肺失清肃。

【症状】发热重，咽喉红肿，痰涕黄稠。

【脉象】
浮脉（表）：脉搏次数多

【标准方】银翘散
en:
Wind-Heat EXTERIOR PATTERN

[Pathogenesis] Wind-Heat invades the Lung and defensive level, disrupting defensive Qi and the Lung's clearing and descending functions.

[Symptoms] Pronounced fever, a red and swollen throat, and thick yellow phlegm and nasal discharge.

[Pulse]
Floating pulse (Exterior): higher pulse frequency

[Standard formula] Honeysuckle and Forsythia Powder

zh_CN:
温燥证

【病机】初秋燥热之邪侵袭肺卫，肺失清润。

【症状】发热恶风，口鼻干燥、咽干口渴、干咳少痰，痰涕黄稠。

【脉象】
浮脉（表）：脉搏次数多，波宽窄

【标准方】桑杏汤
en:
WARM-DRYNESS PATTERN

[Pathogenesis] Warm and dry influences in early autumn invade the Lung and defensive level, impairing the Lung's moistening function.

[Symptoms] Fever with aversion to wind; dry mouth and nose, dry throat and thirst, a dry cough with little phlegm, and thick yellow phlegm or nasal discharge.

[Pulse]
Floating pulse (Exterior): higher pulse frequency, narrower pulse width

[Standard formula] Mulberry Leaf and Apricot Kernel Decoction

zh_CN:
凉燥证

【病机】深秋寒气渐生，燥邪兼风寒侵袭肺卫。

【症状】恶寒发热、鼻塞流清涕、干咳少痰、咽干唇燥、皮肤干燥。

【脉象】
浮脉（表）：脉搏次数少，波宽窄

【标准方】杏苏散
en:
COOL-DRYNESS PATTERN

[Pathogenesis] As cold sets in during late autumn, Dryness together with Wind-Cold invades the Lung and defensive level.

[Symptoms] Aversion to cold with fever, a blocked nose with clear discharge, a dry cough with little phlegm, dry throat and lips, and dry skin.

[Pulse]
Floating pulse (Exterior): lower pulse frequency, narrower pulse width

[Standard formula] Apricot Kernel and Perilla Leaf Powder

zh_CN:
卫气虚

【病机】素体虚弱、久病耗伤肺气，卫气不固、腠理疏松、防御固摄功能减退。

【症状】自汗：不活动也出汗，动则更甚；易感冒：怕风畏冷、不耐风寒，稍受凉即感冒；面色㿠白、气短乏力、神疲懒言；皮肤腠理疏松、常畏风。

【脉象】
浮脉（表）：波峰低

【标准方】玉屏风散
en:
DEFENSIVE QI DEFICIENCY

[Pathogenesis] An inherently weak constitution or prolonged illness depletes Lung Qi. Defensive Qi fails to secure the surface; loose pores weaken protection and containment.

[Symptoms] Spontaneous sweating even at rest, worse with activity; frequent colds, aversion to wind and cold, and catching cold easily; a pale complexion, shortness of breath, fatigue, and little inclination to speak; loose pores and frequent sensitivity to wind.

[Pulse]
Floating pulse (Exterior): decreased amplitude

[Standard formula] Jade Windscreen Powder

zh_CN:
痛痹（寒痹）

【病机】风寒湿邪痹阻经络，寒邪偏盛。寒主收引、凝滞，气血不通则疼痛剧烈。

【症状】肢体关节疼痛剧烈、固定不移；遇寒加重、得温痛减；关节屈伸不利，局部怕冷。

【脉象】
浮脉（表）：波峰高（轻微），脉搏次数少（剧烈），波宽宽（轻微）

【标准方】乌头汤
en:
PAINFUL BI (COLD BI)

[Pathogenesis] Wind-Cold-Damp obstructs the channels, with Cold predominating. Cold contracts and congeals; blocked Qi and blood cause severe pain.

[Symptoms] Severe, fixed pain in the limbs and joints; worse with cold and relieved by warmth; restricted joint movement and local sensitivity to cold.

[Pulse]
Floating pulse (Exterior): slightly increased amplitude, markedly lower pulse frequency, slightly broader pulse width

[Standard formula] Aconite Decoction

zh_CN:
热痹

【病机】风湿热邪侵袭经络关节，或风寒湿邪郁而化热，气血壅滞、经络痹阻。

【症状】关节红肿灼热、疼痛剧烈；触之发热、拒按，得冷稍舒；发热、口渴、烦躁；肢体屈伸不利。

【脉象】
浮脉（表）：波峰高（轻微），脉搏次数多，波宽宽（轻微）

【标准方】白虎桂枝汤
en:
HEAT BI

[Pathogenesis] Wind-Damp-Heat invades the channels and joints, or Wind-Cold-Damp stagnates and turns to Heat. Qi and blood become congested, obstructing the channels.

[Symptoms] Red, swollen, burning joints with severe pain; hot and tender to touch, somewhat relieved by cold; fever, thirst, and irritability; restricted movement of the limbs.

[Pulse]
Floating pulse (Exterior): slightly increased amplitude, higher pulse frequency, slightly broader pulse width

[Standard formula] White Tiger Decoction with Cinnamon Twig

zh_CN:
着痹（湿痹）

【病机】风寒湿邪侵袭，湿邪偏盛；湿性重浊、黏滞，阻滞经络、困遏气机。

【症状】关节沉重酸痛、重着如裹；痛处固定，肌肤麻木、肢体困重；关节肿胀、屈伸不利。
阴雨潮湿天气加重

【脉象】
浮脉（表）：波峰高（轻微），脉搏次数少（轻微），波宽宽（剧烈）

【标准方】薏苡仁汤
en:
FIXED BI (DAMP BI)

[Pathogenesis] Wind-Cold-Damp invades, with Dampness predominating. Its heavy, sticky quality obstructs the channels and impedes the movement of Qi.

[Symptoms] Heavy, aching joints, as though wrapped; fixed pain, skin numbness, and heavy limbs; joint swelling and restricted movement.
Worse in rainy or humid weather.

[Pulse]
Floating pulse (Exterior): slightly increased amplitude, slightly lower pulse frequency, markedly broader pulse width

[Standard formula] Coix Seed Decoction

zh_CN:
行痹（风痹）

【病机】风寒湿邪侵袭经络，以风邪偏盛为主。风性善行、走窜不定。

【症状】肢体关节酸痛，疼痛游走不定，窜走周身。

【脉象】
浮脉（表）：波峰高（剧烈），脉搏次数少（轻微），波宽宽（轻微）

【标准方】防风汤
en:
WANDERING BI (WIND BI)

[Pathogenesis] Wind-Cold-Damp invades the channels, with Wind predominating. Wind moves readily and causes shifting symptoms.

[Symptoms] Aching joints and limbs with pain that shifts from place to place throughout the body.

[Pulse]
Floating pulse (Exterior): markedly increased amplitude, slightly lower pulse frequency, slightly broader pulse width

[Standard formula] Saposhnikovia Decoction

zh_CN:
肺热壅盛

【病机】邪热壅滞于肺，肺失宣降，气机闭塞，热盛气逆。

【症状】咳嗽气粗、喘促胸闷；痰黄黏稠、不易咳出；发热、口渴咽痛；鼻翼煽动，大便偏干，小便黄。

【脉象】
右寸（肺）：脉搏次数多

【标准方】麻杏石甘汤
en:
EXUBERANT HEAT IN THE LUNG

[Pathogenesis] Pathogenic Heat congests the Lung, impairing its dispersing and descending functions; Qi becomes blocked and rises against its normal flow.

[Symptoms] Forceful coughing and wheezing with chest tightness; thick, sticky yellow phlegm that is hard to expectorate; fever, thirst, and sore throat; flaring nostrils, relatively dry stools, and yellow urine.

[Pulse]
Right cun (Lung): higher pulse frequency

[Standard formula] Ephedra, Apricot Kernel, Gypsum and Licorice Decoction

zh_CN:
肺气虚

【病机】肺气不足，宣降无力，卫外不固。

【症状】咳喘无力，气短懒言，动则加重；语声低微、少气乏力；自汗、怕风、易感冒；痰液清稀、量少。

【脉象】
右寸（肺）：波峰低

【标准方】补肺汤
en:
LUNG QI DEFICIENCY

[Pathogenesis] Insufficient Lung Qi weakens its dispersing and descending functions and fails to secure the exterior.

[Symptoms] Weak coughing and wheezing, shortness of breath and reluctance to speak, worse with activity; a weak voice and fatigue; spontaneous sweating, aversion to wind, and frequent colds; scant, thin, clear phlegm.

[Pulse]
Right cun (Lung): decreased amplitude

[Standard formula] Lung-Tonifying Decoction

zh_CN:
痰湿阻肺

【病机】脾失健运，痰湿内生，上壅于肺，肺失宣降。

【症状】咳嗽痰多，色白黏稠、量多易咯；胸闷、气喘、喉间痰鸣；肢体困重，口淡不渴。

【脉象】
右寸（肺）：波宽宽

【标准方】二陈汤
en:
PHLEGM-DAMP OBSTRUCTING THE LUNG

[Pathogenesis] When the Spleen fails to transform and transport, Phlegm-Damp forms internally and accumulates in the Lung, impairing its dispersing and descending functions.

[Symptoms] A cough with abundant white, sticky phlegm that is easy to bring up; chest tightness, wheezing, and rattling phlegm in the throat; heavy limbs and a bland taste without thirst.

[Pulse]
Right cun (Lung): broader pulse width

[Standard formula] Two-Cured Decoction

zh_CN:
肺阴虚

【病机】肺阴亏虚，虚火内生，肺失滋润、清肃无权。

【症状】干咳无痰，或痰少黏稠难咯；咽干口燥、声音嘶哑；潮热盗汗、五心烦热；颧红、形体消瘦。

【脉象】
右寸（肺）：波线细，脉搏次数多，波宽窄

【标准方】沙参麦冬汤
en:
LUNG YIN DEFICIENCY

[Pathogenesis] Depleted Lung Yin gives rise to deficiency Fire; the Lung loses moisture and cannot perform its clearing function.

[Symptoms] A dry cough without phlegm, or a little sticky phlegm that is hard to bring up; dry throat and mouth with hoarseness; tidal fever, night sweats, and heat in the palms, soles, and chest; flushed cheekbones and weight loss.

[Pulse]
Right cun (Lung): thinner pulse line, higher pulse frequency, narrower pulse width

[Standard formula] Adenophora and Ophiopogon Decoction

zh_CN:
痰热壅肺

【病机】邪热入里，灼津成痰、痰热互结，壅遏肺气，肺失宣降。

【症状】咳嗽气喘，痰多黄稠、黏稠难咯；胸闷胸痛，甚则鼻翼煽动；发热口渴、烦躁、大便干结、小便黄。

【脉象】
右寸（肺）：脉搏次数多，波宽宽

【标准方】清气化痰丸
en:
PHLEGM-HEAT CONGESTING THE LUNG

[Pathogenesis] Pathogenic Heat enters the interior and scorches fluids into Phlegm. Phlegm and Heat combine and congest the Lung, impairing its dispersing and descending functions.

[Symptoms] Coughing and wheezing with abundant, thick yellow phlegm that is difficult to bring up; chest tightness and pain, sometimes with flaring nostrils; fever, thirst, irritability, constipation, and yellow urine.

[Pulse]
Right cun (Lung): higher pulse frequency, broader pulse width

[Standard formula] Clear Qi and Transform Phlegm Pill

zh_CN:
表寒里热

【病机】寒邪束表，里有郁热，寒热错杂。

【症状】怕冷无汗，口干咽痛，浑身酸痛怕冷，同时心烦燥热。

【脉象】
浮脉（表）：脉搏次数少
右寸（肺）：脉搏次数多

【标准方】大青龙汤
en:
EXTERIOR COLD WITH INTERIOR HEAT

[Pathogenesis] Cold constrains the exterior while Heat is trapped inside, producing a mixed Cold-Heat pattern.

[Symptoms] Aversion to cold without sweating, dry mouth and sore throat, generalized aches and chills, together with irritability and a sensation of internal heat.

[Pulse]
Floating pulse (Exterior): lower pulse frequency
Right cun (Lung): higher pulse frequency

[Standard formula] Great Azure Dragon Decoction
Exterior Cold with Interior Fluid Retention

zh_CN:
表寒里饮

【病机】外感风寒，寒邪束表；内有水饮伏肺，表里寒邪相合，寒饮壅遏肺气。


【症状】恶寒发热，咳嗽气喘；痰多清稀，胸闷胸满，面部浮肿。


【脉象】
浮脉（表）：脉搏次数少
右寸（肺）：波宽宽

【标准方】小青龙汤
en:
EXTERIOR COLD WITH INTERIOR FLUID RETENTION

[Pathogenesis] External Wind-Cold constrains the surface. Retained fluid within the Lung combines with exterior Cold, obstructing Lung Qi.

[Symptoms] Aversion to cold with fever, coughing and wheezing; copious thin, clear phlegm, chest fullness and tightness, and facial swelling.

[Pulse]
Floating pulse (Exterior): lower pulse frequency
Right cun (Lung): broader pulse width

[Standard formula] Minor Azure Dragon Decoction

zh_CN:
脾气虚

【病机】饮食劳倦、久病耗伤，脾失健运、中气不足、运化失职。

【症状】食少纳呆、脘腹胀满，饭后尤甚；神疲乏力、少气懒言、肢体倦怠；面色萎黄、形体消瘦或浮肿；大便溏薄。

【脉象】
右关（脾）：波峰低

【标准方】四君子汤
en:
SPLEEN QI DEFICIENCY

[Pathogenesis] Poor diet, overwork or prolonged illness depletes the Spleen. Middle Qi becomes weak and the Spleen cannot transform and transport properly.

[Symptoms] Poor appetite and abdominal bloating, especially after meals; fatigue, weakness, little inclination to speak and tired limbs; a sallow complexion with weight loss or swelling; loose stools.

[Pulse]
Right guan (Spleen): decreased amplitude

[Standard formula] Four Gentlemen Decoction

zh_CN:
湿盛困脾

【病机】外感湿邪、或嗜食生冷肥甘，湿邪壅滞、脾阳被困、运化失司，属实证。

【症状】脘腹痞闷、食少纳呆；恶心欲呕、口中黏腻、口淡不渴；头身困重、四肢酸楚、困倦嗜睡；大便溏稀不爽。

【脉象】
右关（脾）：波宽宽

【标准方】平胃散
en:
EXCESS DAMPNESS ENCUMBERING THE SPLEEN

[Pathogenesis] External Dampness, or frequent cold, raw and rich foods, causes Dampness to accumulate. It constrains Spleen Yang and impairs transformation and transport; this is an excess pattern.

[Symptoms] Fullness in the upper abdomen and poor appetite; nausea, a sticky feeling in the mouth and a bland taste without thirst; a heavy head and body, aching limbs and drowsiness; loose, unsatisfying stools.

[Pulse]
Right guan (Spleen): broader pulse width

[Standard formula] Calm the Stomach Powder

zh_CN:
脾阳虚

【病机】脾气久虚，脾阳不足、虚寒内生、运化腐熟无权。

【症状】食少纳呆、脘腹冷痛，喜温喜按；大便清稀溏薄，甚至完谷不化；畏寒肢冷、四肢不温、神疲乏力；口淡不渴、面色㿠白或萎黄；或肢体浮肿、白带清稀量多。

【脉象】
右关（脾）：波峰低，脉搏次数少，波宽宽

【标准方】理中丸
en:
SPLEEN YANG DEFICIENCY

[Pathogenesis] Longstanding Spleen Qi deficiency weakens Spleen Yang. Deficiency Cold develops and the Spleen can no longer transform or digest food effectively.

[Symptoms] Poor appetite and cold abdominal pain relieved by warmth and pressure; thin, loose stools, sometimes with undigested food; aversion to cold, cold limbs and fatigue; a bland taste without thirst and a pale or sallow complexion; possibly swelling or copious, thin, clear vaginal discharge.

[Pulse]
Right guan (Spleen): decreased amplitude, lower pulse frequency, broader pulse width

[Standard formula] Regulate the Middle Pill

zh_CN:
脾虚湿盛

【病机】脾气本虚，运化无力，水湿内生，湿浊内停。

【症状】食少纳呆，脘腹痞闷，饭后胀甚；神疲乏力、少气懒言、四肢困重；大便溏薄、或泄泻、黏滞不爽；面色萎黄，或肢体浮肿、带下量多清稀。

【脉象】
右关（脾）：波峰低，波宽宽

【标准方】参苓白术散
en:
SPLEEN DEFICIENCY WITH EXCESS DAMPNESS

[Pathogenesis] Underlying Spleen Qi deficiency weakens transformation and transport, causing fluids to accumulate as Dampness.

[Symptoms] Poor appetite and abdominal fullness, worse after eating; fatigue, little inclination to speak and heavy limbs; loose stools or diarrhea with a sticky, unsatisfying feeling; a sallow complexion, sometimes with swelling or copious thin, clear vaginal discharge.

[Pulse]
Right guan (Spleen): decreased amplitude, broader pulse width

[Standard formula] Ginseng, Poria and Atractylodes Powder
External Wind-Cold with Internal Damp Stagnation

zh_CN:
外感风寒，内伤湿滞

【病机】外感风寒之邪束表，内伤饮食湿浊阻滞中焦；表有风寒、里有湿滞。

【症状】外感风寒：恶寒发热、头痛身重、无汗、鼻塞流清涕；内伤湿滞：胸膈满闷、脘腹胀痛、恶心呕吐、肠鸣泄泻；怕冷发热 + 又吐又泻、身重胸闷。

【脉象】
浮脉（表）：脉搏次数少
右关（脾）：波宽宽

【标准方】藿香正气散
en:
EXTERNAL Wind-Cold WITH INTERNAL DAMP STAGNATION

[Pathogenesis] External Wind-Cold constrains the surface while dietary injury and Dampness obstruct the middle burner: Wind-Cold outside and Damp stagnation inside.

[Symptoms] External Wind-Cold: aversion to cold with fever, headache and heavy body, no sweating, and a blocked nose with clear discharge; internal Damp stagnation: chest fullness, abdominal distension and pain, nausea, vomiting, bowel sounds and diarrhea; chills and fever with both vomiting and diarrhea, a heavy body and chest tightness.

[Pulse]
Floating pulse (Exterior): lower pulse frequency
Right guan (Spleen): broader pulse width

[Standard formula] Patchouli Qi-Rectifying Powder
Cold Congealing in the Heart Vessels

zh_CN:
寒凝心脉

【病机】素体阳虚，阴寒凝滞，寒邪痹阻心脉、胸阳不振，心脉拘急不通而痛。

【症状】猝然胸痛、痛势剧烈、遇寒加重、得温痛减；胸闷气短、心悸怔忡；畏寒肢冷、面色苍白、唇甲青紫。

【脉象】
左寸（心）：脉搏次数少

【标准方】当归四逆汤
en:
COLD CONGEALING IN THE HEART VESSELS

[Pathogenesis] In a person with underlying Yang deficiency, Cold congeals and obstructs the Heart vessels. Chest Yang is weakened; the constricted vessels cannot carry blood freely, causing pain.

[Symptoms] Sudden, severe chest pain, worse with cold and relieved by warmth; chest tightness, shortness of breath and palpitations; aversion to cold, cold limbs, a pale face, and bluish lips and nails.

[Pulse]
Left cun (Heart): lower pulse frequency

[Standard formula] Chinese Angelica Decoction for Frigid Extremities

zh_CN:
心火亢盛

【病机】心火内炽，火热扰心、灼伤脉络、下移小肠。

【症状】心胸烦热、心悸失眠、烦躁易怒；口舌生疮、舌尖红赤疼痛；口干口苦、面红目赤；小便短赤、灼热涩痛。

【脉象】
左寸（心）：脉搏次数多

【标准方】导赤散
en:
EXUBERANT HEART FIRE

[Pathogenesis] Heart Fire blazes internally, disturbing the mind and scorching the vessels; the Fire also descends to the Small Intestine.

[Symptoms] Heat and agitation in the chest, palpitations, insomnia and irritability; painful mouth and tongue sores and a red, sore tongue tip; dry mouth, bitter taste, a flushed face and red eyes; scant, red urine with burning, difficult urination.

[Pulse]
Left cun (Heart): higher pulse frequency

[Standard formula] Guide Out the Red Powder

zh_CN:
痰迷心窍

【病机】痰湿浊邪蒙蔽心窍，神明失主，多由情志郁结、脾失健运、痰浊内生，上蒙心神所致。

【症状】神志痴呆、精神抑郁、表情淡漠；喃喃自语、举止失常、昏不知人；喉中痰鸣、胸闷痰多、意识模糊；甚则突然昏仆、不省人事。

【脉象】
左寸（心）：波宽宽

【标准方】涤痰汤
en:
PHLEGM OBSCURING THE HEART ORIFICES

[Pathogenesis] Turbid Phlegm-Damp clouds the Heart orifices and disrupts awareness. Emotional constraint and weak Spleen transport may generate Phlegm that rises to disturb the mind.

[Symptoms] Confusion or mental dullness, depression and an indifferent expression; muttering, unusual behavior or reduced awareness; rattling phlegm in the throat, chest tightness, copious phlegm and clouded consciousness; in severe cases, sudden collapse and unconsciousness.

[Pulse]
Left cun (Heart): broader pulse width

[Standard formula] Scour Phlegm Decoction

zh_CN:
心气虚

【病机】心气不足，鼓动无力，心神失养。

【症状】心悸怔忡，活动后加重；气短、胸闷、精神疲倦；自汗，面色淡白。

【脉象】
左寸（心）：波峰低

【标准方】养心汤
en:
HEART QI DEFICIENCY

[Pathogenesis] Insufficient Heart Qi weakens its ability to propel blood and fails to nourish the mind.

[Symptoms] Palpitations, worse with activity; shortness of breath, chest tightness and fatigue; spontaneous sweating and a pale complexion.

[Pulse]
Left cun (Heart): decreased amplitude

[Standard formula] Nourish the Heart Decoction
Blood Stasis Obstructing the Heart Vessels

zh_CN:
心脉瘀阻

【病机】瘀血阻滞心之脉络，气血不通，心失濡养，不通则痛。

【症状】心胸疼痛，心悸心慌，胸闷气短，喘不得卧；面色晦暗、唇甲青紫。

【脉象】
左寸（心）：波线粗

【标准方】血府逐瘀汤
en:
BLOOD STASIS OBSTRUCTING THE HEART VESSELS

[Pathogenesis] Blood stasis blocks the Heart vessels, impedes the circulation of Qi and blood, and deprives the Heart of nourishment. Obstruction causes pain.

[Symptoms] Chest and Heart pain, palpitations, chest tightness, shortness of breath and breathlessness when lying down; a dull complexion and bluish lips and nails.

[Pulse]
Left cun (Heart): thicker pulse line

[Standard formula] Drive Out Stasis in the Mansion of Blood Decoction

zh_CN:
心阴虚

【病机】心阴亏虚，心神失养，虚火内扰。

【症状】心悸怔忡，心慌不安；心烦失眠、多梦易醒；五心烦热、潮热盗汗；口干咽燥、面色颧红。

【脉象】
左寸（心）：波线细，脉搏次数多，波宽窄

【标准方】天王补心丹
en:
HEART YIN DEFICIENCY

[Pathogenesis] Depleted Heart Yin fails to nourish the mind, while deficiency Fire disturbs it internally.

[Symptoms] Palpitations and unease; restlessness, insomnia and frequent waking from dreams; heat in the palms, soles and chest, tidal fever and night sweats; dry mouth and throat with flushed cheekbones.

[Pulse]
Left cun (Heart): thinner pulse line, higher pulse frequency, narrower pulse width

[Standard formula] Heavenly Emperor's Heart-Tonifying Elixir

zh_CN:
心阳虚

【病机】心阳不足，温煦、鼓动无力，虚寒内生。

【症状】心悸怔忡，心慌不安；胸闷气短、遇寒加重；畏寒怕冷、四肢不温；面色㿠白，精神疲乏，自汗。

【脉象】
左寸（心）：波峰低，脉搏次数少

【标准方】桂枝甘草汤
en:
HEART YANG DEFICIENCY

[Pathogenesis] Insufficient Heart Yang cannot warm or propel effectively, giving rise to internal deficiency Cold.

[Symptoms] Palpitations and unease; chest tightness and shortness of breath, worse with cold; aversion to cold and cool limbs; a pale complexion, fatigue and spontaneous sweating.

[Pulse]
Left cun (Heart): decreased amplitude, lower pulse frequency

[Standard formula] Cinnamon Twig and Licorice Decoction

zh_CN:
痰火扰心

【病机】痰浊郁而化火，痰火互结、上扰心神，神明躁动不宁。

【症状】心烦失眠、躁扰不宁、狂躁易怒；多梦易惊、甚至胡言乱语、哭笑无常；胸闷痞满、口苦、痰多黄稠。

【脉象】
左寸（心）：脉搏次数多，波宽宽

【标准方】黄连温胆汤
en:
PHLEGM-FIRE DISTURBING THE HEART

[Pathogenesis] Stagnant Phlegm turns into Fire. Phlegm and Fire combine and rise to disturb the Heart and mind, causing agitation.

[Symptoms] Restlessness, insomnia, agitation and irritability; disturbing dreams, being easily startled, sometimes incoherent speech or inappropriate laughing and crying; chest fullness, a bitter taste and copious thick, yellow phlegm.

[Pulse]
Left cun (Heart): higher pulse frequency, broader pulse width

[Standard formula] Coptis Warm-Gallbladder Decoction

zh_CN:
心脾两虚

【病机】思虑过度、劳倦伤脾、久病体虚、失血过多；脾气虚弱，气血生化不足，心血亏虚、心神失养，属气血两虚、虚证。

【症状】心悸怔忡、失眠多梦、健忘头晕；食欲不振、腹胀便溏、神疲乏力；面色萎黄或苍白、肢体倦怠；女子月经量少色淡、淋漓不尽。

【脉象】
左寸（心）：波线细
右关（脾）：波峰低

【标准方】归脾汤
en:
HEART AND SPLEEN DEFICIENCY

[Pathogenesis] Overthinking, overwork, prolonged illness or blood loss weakens the Spleen. Insufficient production of Qi and blood depletes Heart blood, leaving the mind unnourished; this is a deficiency of both Qi and blood.

[Symptoms] Palpitations, insomnia with vivid dreams, forgetfulness and dizziness; poor appetite, bloating, loose stools and fatigue; a sallow or pale complexion and tired limbs; in women, scant pale menstrual flow or prolonged spotting.

[Pulse]
Left cun (Heart): thinner pulse line
Right guan (Spleen): decreased amplitude

[Standard formula] Restore the Spleen Decoction

zh_CN:
肝火上炎

【病机】肝郁化火、暴怒伤肝，肝火炽盛、气火上逆，属实热证。

【症状】头晕胀痛、面红目赤、急躁易怒；口苦口干、耳鸣耳聋、胁肋灼痛；失眠多梦、甚至狂躁；吐血、衄血。

【脉象】
左关（肝）：脉搏次数多

【标准方】龙胆泻肝汤
en:
LIVER FIRE BLAZING UPWARD

[Pathogenesis] Constrained Liver Qi turns to Fire, or intense anger injures the Liver. Liver Fire blazes and Qi and Fire rise; this is an excess Heat pattern.

[Symptoms] Dizziness with a distending headache, a flushed face, red eyes and irritability; bitter and dry mouth, ringing in the ears or hearing loss, and burning pain along the ribs; insomnia and vivid dreams, possibly agitation; vomiting blood or nosebleeds.

[Pulse]
Left guan (Liver): higher pulse frequency

[Standard formula] Gentian Decoction to Drain the Liver
Cold Stagnating in the Liver Channel

zh_CN:
寒滞肝脉

【病机】外感寒邪、凝滞肝经，肝脉拘急、气血阻滞、阳气被遏，属实寒证。

【症状】少腹冷痛、睾丸坠胀冷痛、疝气痛；巅顶头痛、畏寒喜暖、得温痛减、遇寒加重；四肢厥冷、面色青白。

【脉象】
左关（肝）：脉搏次数少

【标准方】暖肝煎
en:
COLD STAGNATING IN THE LIVER CHANNEL

[Pathogenesis] External Cold congeals in the Liver channel, constricting its vessels, obstructing Qi and blood, and suppressing Yang. This is an excess Cold pattern.

[Symptoms] Cold pain in the lower abdomen; dragging, cold pain in the testicles or hernia pain; pain at the top of the head, aversion to cold, preference for warmth, relief with warmth and worsening with cold; icy limbs and a pale, bluish complexion.

[Pulse]
Left guan (Liver): lower pulse frequency

[Standard formula] Warm the Liver Decoction

zh_CN:
肝气郁结

【病机】情志不遂，肝失疏泄，气机郁滞、经脉不畅。

【症状】胸胁、乳房、少腹胀痛走窜；情绪抑郁、易怒、善太息；咽部异物感（梅核气）、胸闷嗳气；女子月经不调、痛经。

【脉象】
左关（肝）：波峰高

【标准方】柴胡疏肝散
en:
LIVER QI STAGNATION

[Pathogenesis] Emotional frustration impairs the Liver's free flow, causing Qi to stagnate and the channels to become obstructed.

[Symptoms] Moving, distending pain in the chest, flanks, breasts or lower abdomen; low mood, irritability and frequent sighing; a lump sensation in the throat, chest tightness and belching; irregular or painful menstruation.

[Pulse]
Left guan (Liver): increased amplitude

[Standard formula] Bupleurum Liver-Soothing Powder

zh_CN:
肝血虚

【病机】肝血不足，筋脉、目、爪甲、心神失于濡养。

【症状】头晕眼花、视力减退、视物模糊；爪甲干枯脆薄，肢体麻木、筋脉拘挛；面色淡白或萎黄，唇舌色淡；女子月经量少、色淡，甚则闭经；失眠多梦、易惊。

【脉象】
左关（肝）：波线细

【标准方】四物汤
en:
LIVER BLOOD DEFICIENCY

[Pathogenesis] Insufficient Liver blood fails to nourish the sinews, eyes, nails and mind.

[Symptoms] Dizziness, reduced vision and blurred sight; dry, brittle nails, numb limbs and muscle cramps; a pale or sallow complexion and pale lips and tongue; scant, pale menstruation or even absence of periods; restless sleep, vivid dreams and being easily startled.

[Pulse]
Left guan (Liver): thinner pulse line

[Standard formula] Four-Substance Decoction

zh_CN:
肝血瘀滞

【病机】肝气失疏，血行凝滞，瘀血痹阻肝之脉络。

【症状】肌肤甲错，周身瘀斑、蛛丝红缕；胁肋刺痛胀满，情绪压抑、生气后疼痛加重。

【脉象】
左关（肝）：波线粗

【标准方】膈下逐瘀汤
en:
LIVER BLOOD STASIS

[Pathogenesis] Impaired free flow of Liver Qi slows the blood. Blood stasis obstructs the Liver vessels.

[Symptoms] Dry, rough skin, bruising and fine red spider-like markings; stabbing, distending pain along the ribs, low mood and pain that worsens after anger.

[Pulse]
Left guan (Liver): thicker pulse line

[Standard formula] Drive Out Blood Stasis Below the Diaphragm Decoction

zh_CN:
肝阴虚

【病机】情志化火、久病耗伤，肝阴不足、虚火内生、头目筋脉失养。

【症状】头晕耳鸣、两目干涩、视物昏花；胁肋隐隐灼痛、五心烦热；潮热盗汗、口燥咽干、面部烘热；手足蠕动、筋脉拘急。

【脉象】
左关（肝）：波线细，脉搏次数多，波宽窄

【标准方】一贯煎
en:
LIVER YIN DEFICIENCY

[Pathogenesis] Emotional strain generating Fire or prolonged illness depletes Liver Yin. Deficiency Fire arises, leaving the head, eyes and sinews unnourished.

[Symptoms] Dizziness, tinnitus, dry eyes and blurred vision; a faint burning pain in the flanks and heat in the palms, soles and chest; tidal fever, night sweats, dry mouth and throat, and facial flushing; restless or twitching hands and feet with muscle cramps.

[Pulse]
Left guan (Liver): thinner pulse line, higher pulse frequency, narrower pulse width

[Standard formula] Linking Decoction

zh_CN:
肝阳上亢

【病机】肝肾阴虚，阴不制阳、肝阳升发太过、上扰头目，属本虚标实。

【症状】眩晕耳鸣、头目胀痛、面红目赤；急躁易怒、失眠多梦、腰膝酸软；头重脚轻、步履不稳。

【脉象】
左关（肝）：波峰高，脉搏次数多

【标准方】钩藤散
en:
LIVER YANG RISING

[Pathogenesis] Liver and Kidney Yin deficiency cannot restrain Yang. Liver Yang rises excessively to disturb the head and eyes: deficiency at the root, excess in the manifestation.

[Symptoms] Dizziness, tinnitus, a distending headache, a flushed face and red eyes; irritability, insomnia, vivid dreams and aching lower back and knees; a heavy head, light feeling in the feet and unsteady walking.

[Pulse]
Left guan (Liver): increased amplitude, higher pulse frequency

[Standard formula] Uncaria Powder

zh_CN:
肝脾不和（肝郁脾虚）

【病机】情志不舒、肝气郁结，木旺克土；脾虚失运、肝气乘脾。

【症状】胸胁胀痛、善太息、情绪抑郁易怒；脘腹胀满、嗳气食少；腹痛泄泻、泻后痛减；食欲不振、肠鸣矢气多。

【脉象】
左关（肝）：波峰高
右关（脾）：波峰低

【标准方】逍遥散
en:
LIVER-SPLEEN DISHARMONY

[Pathogenesis] Emotional distress constrains Liver Qi, so Wood overacts on Earth. A weakened Spleen fails to transport properly, and Liver Qi overwhelms it.

[Symptoms] Distending pain in the chest and flanks, frequent sighing, low mood and irritability; abdominal fullness, belching and poor appetite; abdominal pain with diarrhea, relieved after a bowel movement; poor appetite, bowel sounds and frequent passing of gas.

[Pulse]
Left guan (Liver): increased amplitude
Right guan (Spleen): decreased amplitude

[Standard formula] Free and Easy Wanderer Powder

zh_CN:
肾不纳气

【病机】久病咳喘、年老肾虚、劳伤肾气；肾气亏虚，下元不固，不能摄纳肺气，气浮于上。属虚喘、肺肾两虚，无明显实邪。

【症状】喘促日久、呼多吸少、动则喘甚；气短不足以息、吸气浅表；腰膝酸软、神疲乏力；或自汗、语声低怯。

【脉象】
右寸（肺）：波峰低
右尺（肾阳）：波峰低

【标准方】人参蛤蚧散
en:
KIDNEY FAILURE TO GRASP QI

[Pathogenesis] Chronic coughing or wheezing, aging or overwork depletes Kidney Qi. The lower source cannot secure and draw down Lung Qi, which rises. This is deficiency wheezing involving both Lung and Kidney, without an obvious excess pathogen.

[Symptoms] Chronic wheezing with a short inhalation and long exhalation, worse with exertion; shortness of breath and shallow inhalation; weak or aching lower back and knees with fatigue; sometimes spontaneous sweating and a weak voice.

[Pulse]
Right cun (Lung): decreased amplitude
Right chi (Kidney Yang): decreased amplitude

[Standard formula] Ginseng and Gecko Powder

zh_CN:
肾阴虚

【病机】久病耗伤、房劳过度、过服温燥，肾阴亏虚、虚火内生、失于滋养。

【症状】腰膝酸痛、眩晕耳鸣、健忘；潮热盗汗、五心烦热、口燥咽干；男子遗精早泄，女子经少、闭经或崩漏；形体消瘦、失眠多梦。

【脉象】
右尺（肾阳）：脉搏次数多

[Pathogenesis] Prolonged illness, excessive sexual activity or too many warming and drying substances depletes Kidney Yin. Deficiency Fire arises and nourishment is lost.

[Symptoms] Aching lower back and knees, dizziness, tinnitus and forgetfulness; tidal fever, night sweats, heat in the palms, soles and chest, and dry mouth and throat; in men, nocturnal emissions or premature ejaculation; in women, scant or absent periods or abnormal uterine bleeding; weight loss, insomnia and vivid dreams.

KIDNEY YANG DEFICIENCY

[Pathogenesis] Aging, prolonged illness or sexual overexertion depletes Kidney Yang. The Fire of the Gate of Life weakens, impairing warmth and fluid transformation.

[Symptoms] Cold, aching and weak lower back and knees; aversion to cold and cold limbs, especially the legs; listlessness and a pale or dark complexion; copious clear urine, frequent urination at night and bed-wetting; in men, erectile dysfunction or premature ejaculation; in women, infertility associated with a cold uterus or thin, clear vaginal discharge; prolonged loose stools, undigested food or diarrhea before dawn.

KIDNEY ESSENCE DEFICIENCY

[Pathogenesis] Weak congenital endowment, excessive later-life depletion, chronic illness or sexual overexertion reduces Kidney essence, which can no longer nourish the bones, brain and reproductive system.

[Symptoms] In children, the 'five delays and five weaknesses': late standing, walking, speech, hair growth and tooth eruption; delayed fontanelle closure, impaired intellectual development and short stature.
In adults, poor nourishment of the brain may cause dizziness, tinnitus, forgetfulness, insomnia and slowed thinking; early aging may cause hair loss, loose teeth or prematurely gray hair. Poor nourishment of the bones can cause weak lower back, knees and legs. Reproductive deficiency may cause low sperm count or infertility in men, and absent periods or infertility in women.

Right chi (Kidney Yang): decreased amplitude
Left chi (Kidney Yin): thinner pulse line

[Pathogenesis] Chronic illness, aging or sexual overexertion depletes Kidney Qi, weakening its ability to store and secure. This is mainly a deficiency pattern without marked Cold or Heat.

zh_CN: 李东璧去各地实地考察，采集样本，参考800多种书籍，历经三次改写，终于完成著作。全书共52卷，载药1892种，方剂11096首，插图1109幅，约190万字。
en: Li Dongbi traveled far and wide to study medicinal plants and collect specimens. Drawing on more than 800 books, he revised his manuscript three times before finally completing it: 52 volumes describing 1,892 medicinal substances and 11,096 prescriptions, with 1,109 illustrations and roughly 1.9 million Chinese characters.

zh_CN: 爹，您写的这部旷世奇书一定要出版发行，让天下人都能用上。
en: Father, this extraordinary book of yours must be published, so people everywhere can put it to use.

zh_CN: 李老先生，打扰啦。在下胡承龙，是做书籍生意的，听说您有书想要刻板发行？
en: Master Li, pardon the intrusion. I am Hu Chenglong, a bookseller. I hear you have a book you wish to have printed?

zh_CN: 辛苦胡老板亲自来一趟，在下确实有一部医书想要拜托您发行。
en: Thank you for coming in person, Master Hu. I do indeed have a medical book I would like you to publish.

zh_CN: 胡承龙大致确认了书的内容
en: Hu Chenglong briefly examined the manuscript.

zh_CN: 哎呀，老先生大作真是让在下佩服，真是古今医书之集大成者啊。
en: What a remarkable work, Master Li! It brings together the finest medical knowledge of past and present.

zh_CN: 胡老板过奖了，您看什么时候能开始刻板？
en: You flatter me, Master Hu. When might you begin carving the printing blocks?

zh_CN: 唉，老先生我就跟您实话实说吧。
en: Master Li, I had best speak frankly.

zh_CN: 您的书确实是医家至宝，可当今世人爱看的是英雄演义，才子佳人，就算发行了恐怕也是卖不出去的。
en: Your book is a treasure for physicians, but readers these days want heroic tales and romances. I fear it would not sell even if we printed it.

zh_CN: 再者，您这大作洋洋洒洒几百万字，还有大量插图。
en: Besides, your manuscript runs to millions of characters and contains a great many illustrations.

zh_CN: 我按市价每百字一钱银子算，再加上油墨，纸张，木料，装订各种费用，初版二十套的发行，我估计要花费两千两白银。
en: At the market rate of one qian of silver per hundred characters, plus ink, paper, wood and binding, I estimate that an initial run of twenty sets would cost two thousand taels of silver.

zh_CN: 虽然您这书确实是好书，可我们也不能做亏本买卖不是。
en: It is an excellent book, but I cannot run my business at a loss.

zh_CN: 您老要是想自己掏钱印书，胡某也不是无情无义之人，我不赚钱，给您按最低的成本价给您发行，您看如何？
en: If you can pay to print it yourself, I will charge you only the bare cost. I would earn nothing from it. What do you say?

zh_CN: 两千两…我上哪弄两千两银子啊…
en: Two thousand taels… Where could I possibly find that much silver?

zh_CN: 老先生您慢慢考虑，在下就先告辞了。
en: Take your time to consider it, Master Li. I shall take my leave.

zh_CN: 爹，今天和书商谈得怎么样？
en: Father, how did the meeting with the bookseller go today?

zh_CN: 那书商说，刻板发行需要两千两银子…
en: He says it will cost two thousand taels of silver to carve the blocks and print the book…

zh_CN: 唉，要是不能出版，我看这书怕是没有多少年头就要失传了…
en: If it cannot be published, I fear the book will be lost within a few years…

zh_CN: 儿子没用，不能给父亲分忧…
en: I have failed you, Father. I cannot help shoulder this burden…

zh_CN: 这是哪儿的话，你可是咱家最有出息的了。
en: Do not say that. You have accomplished more than anyone else in this family.

zh_CN: 你为官清廉，是官场清流，全家都以你为荣。这书的事儿，咱们再想想办法。
en: You are an honest official, a rare bright light in government. We are all proud of you. We will find another way to publish the book.

zh_CN: 老头子，你的恩师顾老先生和当今文坛第一人王世贞是世交，若能请他给你的书写一个序，天下学子必慕名而来，到时候肯定有书商愿意出版此书。
en: Dear, your mentor Master Gu is an old family friend of Wang Shizhen, the leading man of letters today. If Wang wrote a preface for your book, scholars everywhere would seek it out. Surely a bookseller would then agree to publish it.

zh_CN: 哎呀，还得是你啊老婆子，这主意好，这主意好。
en: Ah, my dear, you have done it! What a fine idea!

zh_CN: 儿子明日就去太仓拜访王老先生！
en: I will go to Taicang tomorrow and visit Master Wang!

zh_CN: 爹，我回来了，王老先生给您的书写了序。
en: Father, I am back. Master Wang has written a preface for your book.

zh_CN: 此帝王之秘箓，臣民之重宝。兹集也，藏之深山石室，无当。盖锲之，以共天下后世味太玄如子云者。
en: A secret record fit for emperors, a precious treasure for ministers and common people alike. This collection should not be hidden away in some mountain vault. Let it be carved and printed, so that future generations throughout the world may study its profound mysteries.

zh_CN: 我还去找了胡承龙，他答应出资帮您出书。再加上这些年您医治的病人，咱家的亲戚朋友，也有愿意出钱帮忙的，咱们只要再凑六百两就可以出版此书。
en: I also spoke to Hu Chenglong. He has agreed to contribute to the publication. Some of your former patients, along with our relatives and friends, are willing to help as well. We need only raise another six hundred taels to publish the book.

zh_CN: 六百也不是个小数目，但总归是有盼头了…
en: Six hundred is still a great deal of money, but at least there is hope now…

zh_CN: 万历二十一年李东璧病逝，终年76岁…
en: Li Dongbi died in the twenty-first year of the Wanli reign, aged seventy-six…

zh_CN: 万历二十四年，这部耗尽他一生心血的医书终于刻板发行…
en: In the twenty-fourth year of Wanli, the medical book to which he had devoted his life was finally printed…

zh_CN: 时珍，荆楚鄙人也。幼多羸疾，质成钝椎。僭纂述之权，岁历三十稔，书考八百余家，稿凡三易，复者芟之，阙者缉之，讹者绳之。旧本一千五百二十八种，今增药三百七十四种，分为一十六部，著成五十二卷，僭名曰本草纲目。
en: I, Shizhen, am a humble man of Jingchu. Sickly as a child and slow of mind, I presumed to undertake this compilation. Over thirty years I consulted more than eight hundred works and revised the manuscript three times, cutting repetition, filling gaps and correcting errors. To the 1,528 medicinal substances in earlier works, I added 374, arranged them in sixteen divisions and completed fifty-two volumes. I have dared to call it the Compendium of Materia Medica.

zh_CN: 东璧啊，咱们这医馆已经经营不下去了，我们收拾行李回乡下老家吧…
en: Dongbi, we can no longer keep this clinic open. Let us pack our things and return to our hometown in the countryside…

zh_CN: 因经营不善，医馆被迫关闭
en: The clinic was forced to close after falling into financial difficulty.

zh_CN: 李东璧，有人告你医术不精，招摇撞骗，跟我们去衙门走一趟吧。
en: Li Dongbi, someone has accused you of practicing medicine without skill and deceiving your patients. Come with us to the magistrate's office.
I am innocent! I have been wronged!

zh_CN: 李东璧因行医时过失杀人，被杖四十，永世不得为医。
en: Li Dongbi was found responsible for a patient's death, flogged forty times and forbidden to practice medicine ever again.

zh_CN: 万历二十一年李东璧病逝，终年76岁…
en: Li Dongbi died in the twenty-first year of the Wanli reign, aged seventy-six…

zh_CN: 遗憾的是这部耗尽一生编写的医书，最终没能保存下来…
en: Sadly, the medical book he had spent a lifetime writing was never preserved…

zh_CN: 明嘉靖十九年，武昌府放榜处
en: The examination results are posted in Wuchang Prefecture, in the nineteenth year of the Jiajing reign.

zh_CN: 老爷，榜上没找到少爷的名字。
en: Master, the young master's name is not on the list.

zh_CN: 我看了好几遍了，确实没有少爷的名字...
en: I have checked several times. His name really is not there…

zh_CN: 考了三次都没中举，爹，看来我不是读书的材料...
en: Three attempts, and still no success in the provincial examination. Father, perhaps I am simply not made for scholarship…

zh_CN: 这说的是什么话，你看隔壁村那个老范，考了大半辈子童试，年过半百才中秀才，后来又中了举人，你这才哪儿到哪儿。
en: Do not talk like that. Old Fan from the next village spent most of his life taking the lower examinations. He was over fifty when he finally earned his first degree, and later he passed the provincial examination too. You are still young.

zh_CN: 我看我还是跟您学医吧，科举八股什么的，孩儿实在是学不来…
en: I think I would rather study medicine with you. I simply cannot get the hang of those examination essays…

zh_CN: 学医哪里比得上做官有前途啊，你爹我行医一辈子，辛苦又赚不到钱不说，医得不好还要受人白眼。
en: A career in medicine offers nothing like the prospects of an official post. I have practiced all my life. The work is hard, the pay is poor, and if a treatment goes badly, people look down on you.

zh_CN: 可我真心喜欢研究那些药材方子，考证典籍，不赚钱我也愿意干。
en: But I truly love studying herbs, prescriptions and the old texts. I would do it even if I earned nothing.

zh_CN: 唉......也罢，科举考功名的学子千千万，可真能博取个功名的又有几人呢？东璧呀，你若真的想从医，今日起便随为父从《内经》、《本草》学起吧。
en: Ah… Very well. Thousands pursue an official title through the examinations, but how many ever obtain one? Dongbi, if you truly wish to become a physician, then from today we shall begin with the Inner Canon and the materia medica.

zh_CN: 李东璧十四岁考中秀才，可之后九年间三次参加乡试均告落榜，本就无心科举的李东璧决定开始随父亲学医
en: Li Dongbi passed his first examination at fourteen, but failed the provincial examination three times over the next nine years. With little desire for an official career, he decided to study medicine under his father.

zh_CN: 麻桂相须，增强发汗散寒之力，专治表实无汗。麻杏相使，宣降相配，专治寒邪闭肺之喘逆…
en: Ephedra and cinnamon twig work together to induce sweating and dispel cold, treating an exterior excess pattern without sweat. Ephedra and apricot kernel help the lungs diffuse and descend qi, treating wheezing caused by cold obstructing the lungs…

zh_CN: 相公，晚饭做好了，该吃饭了。
en: Husband, dinner is ready. Come and eat.

zh_CN: 东璧啊，白天教你的都听明白了吗？
en: Dongbi, did you understand everything I taught you today?

zh_CN: 都明白了，平常日子里看您治病，其实已经窥得些门道了。
en: Yes. I have watched you treat patients for years, so I already know a little of how it works.

zh_CN: 学医最要紧的是积累，吃完晚饭去把这些天教你的内容再看一遍，明日一早你随我一起出诊。
en: The most important thing in medicine is to build experience. After dinner, review what I have taught you these past few days. Tomorrow morning, you will accompany me on my rounds.

zh_CN: 从今天起，你就正式开始给病患治病。记住我教给你的，先把脉确定病性，辨证判断所患何病，再因病开方。如果记不住脉象、药方，就翻翻笔记。
en: From today on, you will treat patients yourself. Remember what I taught you: first take the pulse to understand the nature of the illness, then identify the pattern and diagnose the condition before writing a prescription. If you forget a pulse pattern or formula, consult your notes.

zh_CN: 好了，病人已经在等着你了，快去吧。
en: Now then, your patient is waiting. Go on.
Brother Yanwen, it has been too long. I hope you are well.

zh_CN: 哎哟，是日岩兄啊，失迎失迎。
en: Ah, Brother Riyan! Forgive me for not greeting you sooner.

zh_CN: 和我学了一年多医术，现在啊已经能自己出诊了。你还别说，这小子学得挺快，医馆让他打理，我也清闲许多。
en: He has studied medicine with me for over a year and can already see patients on his own. He learns quickly, too. Now that he helps run the clinic, I have more time to rest.
Master Gu, it is an honor to see you.

zh_CN: 正好我这几日不怎么舒服，东璧你给我看看。
en: As it happens, I have not felt well these past few days. Dongbi, would you examine me?

zh_CN: 老师所患的是心阳虚之症，需注意休息，切勿过度操劳，学生这就去给您抓药。
en: Master, you have a deficiency of heart yang. Please rest and avoid overwork. I will prepare your medicine.

zh_CN: 世人皆以为考取功名方为正途，你能认清本心承袭家学，济世安民，难得啊。
en: Most people believe the examinations and an official post are the only proper path. You have recognized your true calling, carried on your family's medicine and chosen to help others. That is rare indeed.

zh_CN: 学生愚钝，辜负了老师的教导…
en: I was a poor student. I have let you down, Master…

zh_CN: 你是我最中意的门生，以前是，现在也是。
en: You were my favorite pupil then, and you still are.

zh_CN: 人生在世不止科举取仕一条路，你能找到一条适合自己的路，为师很欣慰。
en: The examinations are not the only path in life. I am glad you have found one that suits you.

zh_CN: 承蒙老师教诲，学生定不负师恩，精进医术。
en: Thank you for your guidance, Master. I will honor your teaching by improving my medical skills.

zh_CN: 不对，我需要好好想想这是什么病，该开什么方。
en: No, that is not right. I need to think carefully about the illness and the proper prescription.

zh_CN: 哎呀，是老师来了，学生失迎。
en: Master! Forgive me for not welcoming you sooner.

zh_CN: 东璧啊，朝廷来了调令，命我去福建赴任。临走来看看你和你爹。
en: Dongbi, the court has ordered me to take up a post in Fujian. I came to see you and your father before I leave.

zh_CN: 老师请坐，我去给您泡壶茶。
en: Please, have a seat, Master. I will make you some tea.

zh_CN: 嗯，最近如何，学医有什么进展吗？
en: Well, how have you been? How are your medical studies coming along?

zh_CN: 学生行医读书时发现，自《神农本草经》之后，历代本草著作屡经增补改订，其中药材、方子的遗漏、讹误不可枚举。一方之误，害及数人，一药之讹，误尽苍生。
en: As I have practiced and studied, I have found that the materia medica has been expanded and revised many times since the Divine Farmer's Classic. Errors and omissions concerning herbs and prescriptions are beyond counting. A mistaken formula can harm several people; a mistaken herb can harm countless more.

zh_CN: 学生想核对典籍，拾遗补正，重新编写一部能为后人所用的医书。
en: I want to check the old texts, recover what was lost, correct their mistakes and write a new medical book for future generations.

zh_CN: 嗯，好啊东璧，你这想法甚好。
en: A fine ambition, Dongbi. A fine ambition indeed.

zh_CN: 宋儒张载有四句教："为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平"。
en: The Song scholar Zhang Zai wrote: “Establish a heart for Heaven and Earth; secure a life for the people; carry forward the lost learning of the sages; and bring peace to all generations.”

zh_CN: 若是能著成此书，真可谓是为生民立命，为往圣继绝学了啊。
en: If you complete this book, you will truly help secure a life for the people and carry forward the learning of the sages.

zh_CN: 为生民立命，为往圣继绝学…学生记下了。
en: Secure a life for the people, and carry forward the learning of the sages… I will remember that.
Knock, knock… Knock, knock, knock, knock…

zh_CN: 大半夜的谁啊，谁在敲门啊？
en: Who could be knocking in the middle of the night?

zh_CN: 奉楚王谕令，请先生去王府走一趟。
en: By order of the Prince of Chu, you are requested at his residence.

zh_CN: 是什么人病了？要我去看病吗？
en: Is someone ill? Am I being called to treat a patient?

zh_CN: 事关重大您去了就知道了，马车已经备好了，请先生速速启程。
en: It is a matter of great importance. You will learn more when you arrive. The carriage is ready. Please leave at once.

zh_CN: 一夜舟车劳顿，李东璧到了楚王府。
en: After a weary night on the road, Li Dongbi arrived at the Prince of Chu's residence.

zh_CN: 您就是李神医啊，比我想得要年轻许多。请先生来，是小王有事相求。
en: So you are the renowned Physician Li. You are much younger than I expected. I have asked you here because I need your help.

zh_CN: 草民拜见王爷，有什么我能帮上忙的？
en: My respects, Your Highness. How may I help you?

zh_CN: 犬子前些日子突然病倒了，卧床不起。精神萎靡，食欲不振。小王请了好几位大夫，给开了好多方子，都不见好转。眼见着人一天比一天瘦，再这么下去怕是要坏事了…
en: My son suddenly fell ill some days ago and has been confined to bed. He is listless and has no appetite. I have called several physicians and tried many prescriptions, but he has not improved. He grows thinner by the day. I fear what may happen if this continues…

zh_CN: 听闻蕲州李先生医术高明，特请先生来给犬子医治。
en: I heard of your skill in Qizhou, Physician Li, and asked you here to treat my son.

zh_CN: 先生，小王就这么一个儿子，请您救救孩子吧。
en: He is my only son, Doctor. Please save him.

zh_CN: 世子所患的是脾虚湿盛之证，只要按方每日吃药，病情就无大碍了。
en: Your son has spleen deficiency with an excess of dampness. If he takes the medicine as prescribed each day, he should recover well.

zh_CN: 先生真是华佗再世，小王无以为报。这一千两白银是我的一点心意，感谢先生救命之恩。
en: You are Hua Tuo reborn! I cannot thank you enough. Please accept this thousand taels of silver as a token of gratitude for saving his life.

zh_CN: 一千两太多了，草民不能收。
en: A thousand taels is far too much. I cannot accept it.

zh_CN: 少掌柜的，那可是一千两白银啊！
en: Young master, that is a thousand taels of silver!

zh_CN: 世子乃人中龙凤，可草民眼里看到的只有一位需要医治的病人，王爷只需付一两白银诊费即可。
en: Your son is of noble birth, but to me he is simply a patient in need of care. One tael of silver for the consultation will suffice, Your Highness.

zh_CN: ……先生好风骨，本王平日见的那些儒生满口仁义，可见了真金白银没几个不迷糊的。有您这样的大夫是天下苍生之福啊。
en: …You are a man of rare integrity. Many scholars speak of virtue, yet few keep their heads when they see silver. The people are fortunate to have a doctor like you.

zh_CN: 先生的恩情本王记下了，日后有能帮到先生的地方尽管开口。
en: I will remember what you have done. If there is ever anything I can do for you, you need only ask.
Reputation +1000; received one tael of silver.
My son! What is happening to you?

zh_CN: 哎呀，这个…王爷你听我解释…
en: Ah, well… Your Highness, please let me explain…

zh_CN: 来人！把这个挨千刀的江湖骗子给我叉出去剁了！
en: Guards! Drag this damned charlatan out and execute him!

zh_CN: 生意兴隆啊老板，嘿嘿嘿。
en: May business prosper, Master Li. Heh, heh, heh.

zh_CN: 敢问您是？(这人什么时候进来的...)
en: And you are…? (When did he come in…?)

zh_CN: 在下贾荃，是做药材生意的，在湖广省小有一点名气，嘿嘿嘿。
en: I am Jia Quan, a medicinal herb merchant of some repute in Huguang Province. Heh, heh, heh.

zh_CN: 久闻久闻，不知今日来小馆所为何事？
en: Of course I have heard of you. What brings you to my humble clinic today?

zh_CN: 呃，呵呵，今日是想找李神医谈一桩好生意。
en: Well, I have come to discuss a profitable arrangement with the famous Physician Li.

zh_CN: 小可上个月进了一批人参，想请李兄在医馆帮忙出货。
en: I acquired a shipment of ginseng last month. I was hoping you could help me sell it through your clinic.

zh_CN: 小馆平时接待的病患多是平常百姓，人参这种名贵药材用量是不多的。
en: Most of my patients are ordinary people. We have little need for an expensive herb like ginseng.

zh_CN: 李兄此言差矣，人参是补药，是病就得补。像那种头疼脑热的小病您也给加一点，这量不就有了嘛。
en: You are looking at it all wrong, Brother Li. Ginseng is a tonic. Every illness needs a tonic! Add a little even for a headache or a fever, and you will move plenty of it.

zh_CN: 按病开方岂能胡乱加药？
en: How could I add herbs at random instead of prescribing for the patient's condition?

zh_CN: 不白加，每斤人参我给您一两白银的提成，怎么样，是桩好生意吧。
en: You would not be doing it for nothing. I will pay you one tael of silver for every jin of ginseng you sell. A fine arrangement, is it not?

zh_CN: 您还是请回吧，陈皮，送客。
en: I think you should leave. Chen Pi, show our guest out.
Hmph. You do not know a good offer when you see one.
My friend, it has been a while. I hope you are well.
Captain Lei! It is good to see you again.

zh_CN: 哎呀，老毛病犯了，又得麻烦你啦。
en: My old trouble has flared up. I am afraid I must impose on you again.
It is no trouble. Please, sit down.

zh_CN: 雷兄，你这肝阳上亢的老毛病，除了吃药，还得注意控制情绪，切莫扰动肝火。
en: Brother Lei, your liver yang is rising again. Along with taking the medicine, you must keep your temper in check and avoid stirring up liver fire.

zh_CN: 哎呀，这都被你看出来啦。
en: Ha! You saw right through me.

zh_CN: 昨日我带着兄弟们和州府的征粮官去收粮，这帮狗腿子淋尖踢斛下脚那叫一个狠，气得我当场骂娘。
en: Yesterday my men and I accompanied the prefecture's grain tax collectors. Those lackeys were heaping and kicking the measures so hard that I cursed them on the spot.
What do you mean by “heaping and kicking the measures”?

zh_CN: 贤弟你有所不知，百姓交粮时，要把粮食倒进斛里，堆得高出斛口，堆成尖尖的，这叫"淋尖"。
en: When common folk pay their grain tax, they pour grain into a measuring vessel until it forms a mound above the rim. That is the “heaping.”

zh_CN: 官吏再踢一脚斛，那些被震落、洒在斛外的粮食，不算入百姓缴纳的赋税，直接入了这帮狗腿子的口袋。
en: Then an official kicks the vessel. The grain that spills out does not count toward the tax. Those lackeys pocket it instead.

zh_CN: 现在这淋尖踢斛已经是各处不成文的规矩了，但昨天那帮混蛋踢得太狠，简直成明抢了。
en: It has become an unwritten rule everywhere, but yesterday those scoundrels kicked so hard it was open robbery.

zh_CN: 百姓的日子是越来越不好过了，我去给你抓药，雷兄稍候。
en: Life is getting harder for the people. I will prepare your medicine, Brother Lei. Please wait here.

zh_CN: 不对，我需要好好想想这是什么病，该开什么方。
en: No, that is not right. I need to think carefully about the illness and the proper prescription.

zh_CN: 大夫大夫！救命啊大夫！我家老爷要不行了！
en: Doctor! Doctor, help! My master is dying!

zh_CN: 我家老爷刚才在醉仙楼喝酒，突然就开始胡言乱语，神志不清了。
en: He was drinking at the Drunken Immortal Tavern when he suddenly began speaking nonsense. He no longer knows what is going on.

zh_CN: 我是湖广首富！哈哈哈哈，我看谁再敢小看我！
en: I am the richest man in Huguang! Ha, ha, ha! Let us see who dares look down on me now!

zh_CN: 这不是贾老板吗，快把他抬过来。
en: Is that Master Jia? Bring him over here, quickly.

zh_CN: 我有一桩大买卖，天大的买卖！呕~
en: I have a grand deal, the greatest deal of all! Urgh…

zh_CN: 贾老板的神志不清是由痰火扰心所致，心情大起大落再加上饮酒过度，使病情加剧。需要戒酒静养，按时服药。
en: Master Jia's confusion was caused by phlegm fire disturbing the heart. Strong swings in mood and too much wine made it worse. He must avoid alcohol, rest and take his medicine regularly.

zh_CN: 真是太谢谢先生了，老爷，我们走吧。
en: Thank you so much, Doctor. Come, Master, let us go home.

zh_CN: 这贾老板怎么突然犯病了呀？我看是这个奸商干坏事儿遭报应了。
en: Why did Master Jia suddenly fall ill? I bet that crooked merchant is getting what he deserves.

zh_CN: 别乱说，快去把他吐的地方收拾收拾，还有病患要看病呢。
en: Do not say that. Clean up where he was sick. We still have patients to see.

zh_CN: 不对，我需要好好想想这是什么病，该开什么方。
en: No, that is not right. I need to think carefully about the illness and the proper prescription.

zh_CN: 李大夫，知州大人请您去州衙有事商议。
en: Doctor Li, the prefect requests your presence at the government office.
Understood. I will go at once.

zh_CN: 今日召诸位来，是朝廷有旨意下达。
en: I have summoned you all today to convey an order from the court.

zh_CN: 浙江省淳安建德两县突发水灾，周边各地已有瘟疫出现，朝廷为防止疫情扩散，特令周边州府发放赈灾药材。
en: Flooding has struck Chun'an and Jiande counties in Zhejiang. Disease has already appeared in nearby districts. To prevent an epidemic from spreading, the court has ordered surrounding prefectures to distribute medicinal supplies for disaster relief.

zh_CN: 昨日，赈灾药材已采办完备，这次除了惠民药局，还要各医馆药铺配合诊治病患、发放药材。
en: The supplies were procured yesterday. This time, private clinics and apothecaries must help the public dispensary treat patients and distribute medicine.

zh_CN: 一会儿诸位就去库房画押登记，明日起官府会张贴榜文，通知百姓就近领取药材。
en: You will sign the register at the storehouse shortly. Starting tomorrow, the authorities will post notices telling residents where to collect medicine nearby.

zh_CN: 诸位到我这画押，排好队一个一个来，写好收货地址，我们会专门派人运送。
en: Line up here to sign, one at a time. Write down your delivery address and we will send someone with the supplies.

zh_CN: 李大夫您在这画押，上面催得紧，我们赶着发运呢。
en: Doctor Li, please sign here. Our superiors are pressing us to dispatch everything quickly.

zh_CN: 东璧回来啦，什么事儿啊，一大早就被叫去了？
en: Dongbi, you are back. Why did they call you away so early?

zh_CN: 朝廷调拨了赈灾药材，这次不光惠民药局，咱们这些医馆药铺也要一起帮忙发放。
en: The court has sent medicine for disaster relief. This time, our clinics and apothecaries must help distribute it alongside the public dispensary.

zh_CN: 这几日我去菜市街买菜的时候，看到不少流民在城东，大灾之后必有大疫，朝廷这次赈灾太及时了。
en: I have seen many displaced people in the east of town on my way to the market. A great disaster is often followed by an epidemic. The relief could not have come sooner.

zh_CN: 陈皮，跟我去后院收拾收拾库房，一会儿药材就要送来了，得赶紧腾出地方。
en: Chen Pi, come help me clear the storeroom out back. The medicine will arrive soon, and we need to make room.

zh_CN: 数目都对，有劳几位了，进来喝点水吧。
en: The count is correct. Thank you, gentlemen. Would you come in for some water?

zh_CN: 还有公务在身，就不劳烦李太医啦，兄弟们，走了！
en: We are still on duty, Doctor Li. No need to trouble yourself. Men, let us go!

zh_CN: 嗯，我都点数过了，这次是按份分装的，倒省得咱们再称量，不错不错。
en: Yes, I counted it all. It has already been packed into individual portions, so we will not need to weigh it ourselves. Excellent.

zh_CN: 明日我带着芷兰他们发药，医馆的活计你好生照看。
en: Tomorrow I will distribute the medicine with Zhilan and the others. You look after the clinic.

zh_CN: 忙活了一天，药材发得差不多了，咱们家也该把药喝了。我看看这次开的是什么方子。
en: After a full day's work, we have handed out nearly all the supplies. We should take our own medicine too. Let me see what formula they have given us.

zh_CN: 嗯…有藿香，有紫苏，应该是藿香正气散的方子。
en: Hmm… Agastache and perilla leaf. This should be Agastache Powder to Rectify the Qi.

zh_CN: 嗯？…味道不对啊，这药里怎么掺了面粉？厚朴里也混杂了树皮充数。
en: Hm? It does not taste right. Why is flour mixed in with the medicine? They have bulked out the magnolia bark with ordinary tree bark, too.

zh_CN: 我尝尝…藿香用的是梗，气味微薄。
en: Let me taste it… They used agastache stems. The aroma is weak.

zh_CN: 这…连赈灾药材都敢动手脚…
en: They even dared tamper with medicine meant for disaster relief…

zh_CN: 赈灾药材事关重大，我们得上报官府。
en: These supplies are too important. We must report this to the authorities.

zh_CN: 明日我去药剂局跟孙大夫商量商量。
en: Tomorrow I will discuss it with Doctor Sun at the dispensary.

zh_CN: 坏事了坏事了，孙大夫被抓了。
en: Something terrible has happened! Doctor Sun has been arrested!

zh_CN: 孙大夫也发现赈灾药材有问题，去州衙找吴世良，谁知被扣了个私换药材的罪名，打了二十板子关进大狱里了。
en: Doctor Sun noticed the problems with the relief medicine too. He went to confront Wu Shiliang at the prefectural office. Instead, they accused him of secretly swapping the medicine, flogged him twenty times and threw him in prison.

zh_CN: 这个吴世良，平日里看着人模狗样的，真不是个东西啊。
en: Wu Shiliang always looked respectable, but he is rotten to the core.

zh_CN: 我们得给孙大夫讨回公道。
en: We have to seek justice for Doctor Sun.

zh_CN: 儿啊，我看咱们还是别蹚浑水了，多一事不如少一事，明哲保身吧。这不是咱们平民百姓管得了的。
en: Son, I think we should stay out of this. Better to keep our heads down. Ordinary people like us cannot fight the authorities.

zh_CN: 贤弟，好久不见啊，今天来抓点药顺便来看看你。
en: My friend, it has been too long. I came to pick up some medicine and thought I would visit you.
What is troubling you, Brother Lei?

zh_CN: 这次省内各州县的赈灾药材都要从咱们蕲州调拨，我奉命押送，全省各处跑，路上染了点风寒。
en: All the disaster relief medicine for the province is being sent out from Qizhou. I was ordered to escort shipments from place to place, and I caught a chill on the road.
The whole province is receiving supplies from Qizhou?

zh_CN: 是啊，这次的药材统一由蕲州采办存放，哪里缺药就从咱们这调拨。
en: Yes. All the medicine is bought and stored here, then sent wherever it is needed.

zh_CN: 有件事儿你知道吗？这次的赈灾药材被人动了手脚，以次充好，根本治不了病。
en: Have you heard? Someone has tampered with these relief supplies. They have replaced good medicine with poor quality stock. It cannot cure anyone.

zh_CN: 药剂局的孙大夫去找吴世良理论，被关进大牢，知情的大夫们都不敢声张。
en: Doctor Sun from the dispensary challenged Wu Shiliang about it and was imprisoned. The other doctors who know are afraid to speak up.

zh_CN: 他娘的，没有王法了！这州府衙门肯定是不能去了，我到武昌府湖广按察司，把这事报上去。
en: Damn them! Has the law lost all meaning? We cannot go to the local officials. I will report this to the Huguang Provincial Surveillance Commission in Wuchang.

zh_CN: 雷兄这一趟要多加小心啊。
en: Take care on the journey, Brother Lei.
Doctor Li, it is a pleasure to see you.

zh_CN: 最近有点失眠，没什么食欲，来请李大夫给看看。
en: I have been sleeping poorly and have little appetite. I hoped you would examine me.

zh_CN: 先生这是心脾两虚之症，思虑过度暗耗心血导致心血不足，脾气虚弱。给您开一服归脾汤，您可要注意休息啊。
en: You have a deficiency of both heart and spleen. Too much worry has depleted your heart blood and weakened your spleen qi. I will prescribe Restore the Spleen Decoction. Please make sure you rest.

zh_CN: 李神医名不虚传，这阵子确实是公务繁忙，做钱谷师爷这一行，一刻也不得闲啊。
en: Your reputation is well deserved. Official business has kept me very busy. A financial secretary never has a moment to spare.

zh_CN: 先生是操劳赈灾药材的采办之事？
en: Have you been occupied with buying the relief medicine?

zh_CN: 这是衙门公务，在下不方便说，也劝李大夫不要打听衙门的事。
en: That is government business. I cannot discuss it, and I advise you not to inquire into official affairs.

zh_CN: 无妨，您和令尊医术高明，赈灾药材用的是什么，想必你们心里有数。
en: No matter. You and your father are skilled physicians. I imagine you know exactly what is in the relief medicine.

zh_CN: 但我得提醒您一句，赈灾药材不只是一两个州府的事，更不是你我能管的事。
en: But let me warn you: these supplies concern more than one or two prefectures. Neither you nor I can set things right.

zh_CN: 先生医术闻名全省，在下十分钦佩，不要浪费了老天给您的才华。在下告辞。
en: Your medical skill is renowned throughout the province, and I admire it greatly. Do not squander the gift Heaven has given you. I shall take my leave.

zh_CN: 不对，我需要好好想想这是什么病，该开什么方。
en: No, that is not right. I need to think carefully about the illness and the proper prescription.

zh_CN: 雷兄，怎么样，事情有眉目了吗？
en: Brother Lei! Have you made any progress?

zh_CN: 唉…按察司、布政司都不受理，去所部都指挥使司面见老宪台，他老人家说这里面水太深，让我别多管闲事…
en: No… Neither the provincial surveillance office nor the provincial administration would hear the case. I even went to see the commander at the military commission. He said the matter runs too deep and told me to stay out of it…

zh_CN: 看来这事远比我们想的复杂…
en: Then this is far more complicated than we thought…

zh_CN: 放任不管的话，是要出大事的...
en: If we let it go, something terrible will happen…

zh_CN: 我想到了一个能帮上忙的人。
en: I know someone who might help.

zh_CN: 贤弟认识这么大的人物？
之前医治过世子，应该能说得上话。
en: I treated his son. He may be willing to hear me out.

zh_CN: 那还等什么，我陪你现在就去！
en: Then what are we waiting for? I will go with you now!

zh_CN: 一路无话，两人来到了楚王府
en: The two traveled to the Prince of Chu's residence in silence.

zh_CN: 前日一别，先生别来无恙啊。
en: Doctor Li, it is good to see you again.

zh_CN: 草民拜见王爷，今日来是有一事请王爷帮忙。
en: My respects, Your Highness. I have come to ask for your help.

zh_CN: 先生是犬子的救命恩人，若有本王能帮上忙的，一定尽力而为。
en: You saved my son's life. If there is anything within my power, I will do my best.

zh_CN: 李东璧将事情的前因后果如实告诉了楚王
en: Li Dongbi told the Prince of Chu everything that had happened.

zh_CN: 嗯…这些地方官胆子也太大了。可自成祖文皇帝之后，藩王不临民，不治事，干预地方军政是谋逆的大罪，本王也爱莫能助。
en: Hmm… These local officials are brazen indeed. But since the reign of the Yongle Emperor, imperial princes have been forbidden to govern the people or interfere in local military and civil affairs. To do so would be treated as treason. I fear I cannot intervene.

zh_CN: 这事儿要是您不管，就没人能管了…瘟病若起，湖广将民不聊生啊。
en: If you do nothing, no one can… If an epidemic breaks out, the people of Huguang will suffer terribly.

zh_CN: 此事牵扯甚广，先生就不怕引火烧身吗？
en: Many people are implicated. Are you not afraid of putting yourself in danger?

zh_CN: 草民自幼读四书五经，诸子百家，文章未成，功名未就，所学所求只有为生民立命，若以我一命换千万民生，吾往矣。
en: Since childhood I have studied the classics and the teachings of the sages. I have written no great work and earned no official title. All I have learned, all I seek, is to help the people live. If my one life can save millions, I will give it gladly.

zh_CN: 先生所言让本王惭愧啊…待本王修一道密疏，向圣上禀明此事。先生也切莫再向他人提及。
en: Your words put me to shame… I will send a secret memorial to His Majesty explaining the matter. But you must speak of this to no one else.

zh_CN: 是沈先生啊，病好点了吗？
en: Master Shen, are you feeling any better?
I do not have much time left.

zh_CN: 啊？您的病没那么严重，只要按时吃药好好休息肯定会好起来的。
en: What? Your illness is not that serious. Take the medicine and get enough rest, and you will recover.

zh_CN: 治得了病，治不了命。今天来是有样东西要交给李大夫。
en: Medicine can cure an illness, but it cannot change one's fate. I came to give you something.

zh_CN: 这是吴世良让我写的账册抄本，交给您应该能派上用场。
en: A copy of the accounts Wu Shiliang ordered me to keep. I think it will be useful in your hands.

zh_CN: 说实话我很羡慕李大夫，所学的本事能有处施展，唉…小生就此别过。
en: To tell the truth, I envy you. Your abilities can be put to good use. Ah… Farewell, Doctor Li.

zh_CN: 获得赈灾药材账本抄本
en: Obtained a copy of the disaster relief medicine accounts.

zh_CN: 李大夫，我这两天腰酸腿软，夜尿还多，给我开点药吧。
en: Doctor Li, my lower back and legs have felt weak these past few days, and I keep waking to urinate. Could you prescribe something?

zh_CN: 杨大使所患的是肾气不固之症，要注意休养，最近是遇到什么事受了惊吗？
en: You have a failure of the kidneys to secure qi. You need rest. Has something frightened you recently?

zh_CN: 您听说沈师爷的事了吗？
en: Have you heard what happened to Secretary Shen?

zh_CN: 昨天沈师爷在自己屋里死了…
en: They found him dead in his room yesterday…

zh_CN: 他们开始灭口了...下一个就该轮到我了...
en: They have begun silencing witnesses… I will be next…

zh_CN: 这一批药材入库验收、各地调拨都是我经的手，多少药、什么成色、送到哪里，账上都有我的画押。他们想把这笔账做干净，就不会留我这个活口。
en: I oversaw the receipt of that shipment and its dispatch to each district. How much medicine there was, its quality, where it went—my signature is on every entry. If they want to erase the trail, they cannot leave me alive.

zh_CN: 不对，我需要好好想想这是什么病，该开什么方。
en: No, that is not right. I need to think carefully about the illness and the proper prescription.
“The storeroom is on fire! Somebody help!”

zh_CN: 少掌柜的，惠民药局的药料库起火啦！
en: Young master, the public dispensary's medicine storehouse is burning!
There is something suspicious about this fire.
They are carrying someone out over there.

zh_CN: 掌柜的生意兴隆啊(四处打量...)，那扇门是通后院的吧？
en: Business looks good, Master Li. (Looks around…) That door leads to the rear courtyard, does it?
May I ask what brings you to my clinic?

zh_CN: 啊，哈哈，没事没事，就来看看，听说咱蕲州有一位李神医，来瞻仰瞻仰。
en: Oh, ha, ha, nothing in particular. I heard Qizhou had a famous Physician Li and came to see him for myself.

zh_CN: 小馆还要接待病患，无事便请回吧。
en: We have patients to see. If you have no business here, please leave.

zh_CN: 切，那咱们就后会有期了。
李大夫，我来送你上路啦。
en: Doctor Li, I have come to send you to the next world.

zh_CN: 贤弟，你没事吧？王爷听说沈修文和杨善泉都被灭口了，猜想下一个就是你，便派我们在暗中保护。
en: My friend, are you all right? When His Highness heard that Shen Xiuwen and Yang Shanquan had both been silenced, he feared you would be next. He sent us to protect you in secret.
It is a misunderstanding, sir! A misunderstanding!
The group arrived at the prince's residence.
Your Highness, we have brought them all here.

zh_CN: 这几位是朝廷派来查赈灾药材案的钦差。
en: These gentlemen are imperial investigators sent to examine the disaster relief medicine case.

zh_CN: 北镇抚司陆丁，你就是李东璧？
en: Lu Ding of the Northern Pacification Office. Are you Li Dongbi?

zh_CN: 李东璧将前前后后发生的事情一五一十地禀明钦差
en: Li Dongbi gave the imperial investigators a full account of everything that had happened.

zh_CN: 蕲州赈灾药材贪污案惊动朝廷，锦衣卫奉旨查办，地方涉案官员数十人，贪污银钱近万两。
en: The corruption of Qizhou's disaster relief medicine drew the court's attention. The Imperial Guards were ordered to investigate. Dozens of local officials were implicated, and nearly ten thousand taels of silver had been embezzled.

zh_CN: 主犯吴世良、赵顺等即刻斩首。湖广巡抚陈仕贤等，连坐失察，官降两级。
en: The principal offenders, including Wu Shiliang and Zhao Shun, were executed at once. Chen Shixian, governor of Huguang, and others were demoted two ranks for failing to uncover the crime.

zh_CN: 蕲州所需赈灾药材由太医院调拨，重新发放。
en: The Imperial Medical Academy supplied a new shipment of relief medicine for Qizhou to distribute.

zh_CN: 到头来这吴世良不过是个被推出来顶罪的罢了。
en: In the end, Wu Shiliang was little more than a scapegoat.

zh_CN: 朝政被严党把持，这些做官的你中有我，我中有你，真细究起来又是一笔糊涂账。
en: The Yan faction controls the court. Every official has ties to another. If anyone truly followed the trail, it would lead into a hopeless tangle.

zh_CN: 这次我上奏皇上，除了赈灾药材一案，还将先生举荐给朝廷。正好太医院院判一职空缺，特批先生赴任。
en: When I reported the medicine case to His Majesty, I also recommended you for service at court. A deputy director's post at the Imperial Medical Academy happened to be vacant, and His Majesty has approved your appointment.

zh_CN: 多谢王爷提拔，可草民荆楚鄙人，幼多羸疾，质成钝椎，实在是力不从心。
en: Thank you for your kindness, Your Highness. But I am only a humble man of Jingchu, sickly since childhood and slow of mind. I fear I am not equal to the task.

zh_CN: ……既然如此，那本王就不强人所难了。
en: …Very well. I will not press you.

zh_CN: 咳咳咳，咳咳，大夫，我这嗓子嗓子也不知怎么了，又疼又痒，咳得嗓子都哑了。
en: Cough, cough… Doctor, I do not know what has happened to my throat. It hurts and itches, and I have coughed until my voice is hoarse.

zh_CN: 您这是温燥证，整日说书久坐少动，伤津耗气，易生内热。
en: You have a warm dryness pattern. Sitting and telling stories all day without much movement has depleted your fluids and qi, making you prone to internal heat.

zh_CN: 给您开一副桑杏汤，一天三服，也记得多喝水。
en: I will prescribe Mulberry Leaf and Apricot Kernel Decoction, three doses a day. Remember to drink plenty of water too.

zh_CN: 柳先生，我最喜欢听您说书啦，您真是啥都知道啥都会，讲什么像什么。
en: Master Liu, I love hearing your stories! You know everything, and you bring every tale to life.

zh_CN: 诶嘿嘿，小兄弟过奖了，我只是说些王侯将相，才子佳人的故事，来听书的客官喜欢什么，我就讲什么。
en: Heh, heh. You flatter me, young man. I only tell tales of kings and generals, scholars and beauties. I tell the audience whatever they want to hear.

zh_CN: 先生，您现在就在这讲一段吧。
en: Please tell us a story now, Master Liu.

zh_CN: 人家柳先生还病着呢，你们别在这胡闹。
en: Master Liu is still ill. Stop pestering him.

zh_CN: 无妨，呵呵，那就说一个王道士胡诌妒妇方。
en: It is all right. Let me tell you the tale of Daoist Wang and his remedy for jealousy.

zh_CN: 说京城有一富商，娶了位善妒的夫人，家中鸡飞狗跳无一日安宁。他的朋友觉得这是病，得找人医治。
en: Once, a wealthy merchant in the capital married a very jealous woman. Their home knew no peace. A friend decided her jealousy was an illness that needed a cure.

zh_CN: 正巧天齐庙有位摆摊卖膏药的王道士，因膏药灵验得名王一贴，富商的朋友便去求方问药。
en: At Tianqi Temple, a Daoist called Wang sold medicinal plasters. His plasters were so effective that everyone called him Wang the One-Plaster Wonder. The friend went to ask him for a remedy.

zh_CN: 王一贴道：“这贴妒的膏药倒没经过。有一种汤药，或者可医，只是慢些儿，不能立刻见效的。”
en: Wang said, “I have never made a plaster for jealousy. There is a decoction that might help, but it works slowly. Do not expect an immediate cure.”

zh_CN: 朋友问：“什么汤？怎么吃法？”
en: The friend asked, “What decoction? How does she take it?”

zh_CN: 王一贴道：“这叫做‘疗妒汤’。用极好的秋梨一个，二钱冰糖，一钱陈皮，水三碗，梨熟为度。每日清晨吃这一个梨，吃来吃去就好了。”
en: Wang replied, “It is called Jealousy-Curing Decoction. Take one fine autumn pear, two qian of rock sugar and one qian of aged tangerine peel. Boil them in three bowls of water until the pear is tender. Have her eat one pear each morning. Keep at it, and she will get better.”

zh_CN: 朋友道：“这也不值什么。只怕未必见效。”
en: “That costs next to nothing,” the friend said. “But will it really work?”

zh_CN: 王一贴道：“一剂不效，吃十剂；今日不效，明日再吃；今年不效，明年再吃。”
en: Wang replied, “If one dose fails, give her ten. If it fails today, try tomorrow. If it fails this year, try again next year.”

zh_CN: “横竖这三味药都是润肺开胃不伤人的，甜丝丝的，又止咳嗽，又好吃。吃过一百岁，人横竖是要死的，死了还妒什么？那时就见效了。”
en: “After all, these ingredients soothe the lungs and aid the appetite. They are sweet, tasty and ease a cough. They will do her no harm. Once she is past a hundred, she must die someday. And once she is dead, she cannot be jealous. Then you will see it has worked!”
Ha, ha, ha! What sort of prescription is that?

zh_CN: 哈哈哈，这道士说的也不无道理。
en: Ha, ha, ha! The Daoist does have a point.

zh_CN: 不对，我需要好好想想这是什么病，该开什么方。
en: No, that is not right. I need to think carefully about the illness and the proper prescription.

zh_CN: 李大夫，您快给我女儿瞧瞧吧，这孩子整日茶饭不进，愁眉苦脸咳个不停。
en: Doctor Li, please examine my daughter. She hardly eats or drinks, looks miserable all day and cannot stop coughing.

zh_CN: 哎呀，可不是嘛，这孩子随我学艺两年又半载，尤善歌舞，是咱柳月坊的花魁。
en: Why, of course! She has studied with me for two and a half years. She is a fine singer and dancer, the star of our Willow Moon House.

zh_CN: 可你看她现在这个样子，还怎么接待客人啊。
en: But look at her now. How is she supposed to entertain guests like this?

zh_CN: 姑娘你坐下，我给你把把脉。哎，半夏你在这干什么？
en: Please sit down, miss. I will take your pulse. Banxia, what are you doing here?
The young mistress sent me to keep an eye on you.

zh_CN: 姑娘这病是肺气虚，平日注意避风避寒，开副补肺汤调养调养。早上练练六字诀中的呬字诀，舒畅胸中气机。
en: You have a deficiency of lung qi. Keep warm and avoid the wind. I will prescribe a Lung-Tonifying Decoction. In the mornings, practice the “si” sound of the Six Healing Sounds to ease the flow of qi in your chest.

zh_CN: 成天好吃好喝的伺候着，她能有什么心事。
en: She eats and drinks well every day. What could she possibly be worried about?

zh_CN: 那就多谢大夫了，走吧女儿。
en: Thank you, Doctor. Come along, daughter.

zh_CN: 大夫，刚才那姑娘是得了什么病啊？
en: Doctor, what was wrong with the young woman who just left?

zh_CN: 小生是姑娘的一位相识，担心姑娘身体，来问问大夫。
en: I am an acquaintance of hers. I am worried about her health and came to ask.

zh_CN: 哦，那姑娘所患的是肺气虚，并无大碍，只是看起来似乎有心事。您可知其中原委？
en: She has a deficiency of lung qi. It is not serious, but she seems deeply troubled. Do you know why?

zh_CN: 哎哟？这里面有事儿，快说来听听。
en: Oh? There is a story here? Tell us!

zh_CN: 实不相瞒，小生在柳月坊与飞燕相识，一见倾心，私底下定了终身。
en: To be honest, I met Feiyan at Willow Moon House. We fell in love at first sight and privately pledged to marry.

zh_CN: 原想着凑够五百两银子，给她赎身。可那老鸨坐地起价，张口就要一千两，这让我们上哪去凑这么多银子啊…
en: I hoped to save five hundred taels to buy her freedom. But the madam doubled the price to a thousand. How could we ever raise that much silver?

zh_CN: 想必姑娘是因为这事急坏了身子。
en: No wonder her health has suffered from worry.

zh_CN: 唉，又是一对儿苦命的鸳鸯。
en: Ah, another pair of ill-fated lovers.

zh_CN: 相公咱想办法帮帮他们吧。
en: Dear, we should find a way to help them.

zh_CN: 我也想帮他们，可怎么帮呢？
en: I would like to, but how?

zh_CN: 不对，我需要好好想想这是什么病，该开什么方。
en: No, that is not right. I need to think carefully about the illness and the proper prescription.

zh_CN: 姑娘你来啦，病好点了吗？
en: You have come back, miss. Are you feeling any better?

zh_CN: 唉，这些日子一直不太好，前天还咳出血丝来了…
en: Not really. I even coughed up a little blood the day before yesterday…
Please sit. I will examine you again.

zh_CN: 姑娘你这病，因气虚日久，气不化津，已经恶化为肺阴虚了。给你开些沙参麦冬汤补津养肺。
en: Your longstanding qi deficiency has kept fluids from forming, and your condition has progressed to a deficiency of lung yin. I will prescribe Glehnia and Ophiopogon Decoction to nourish your fluids and lungs.

zh_CN: 可这药只能医肺病，不能医心病，心病还须心药医。
en: But medicine can only treat your lungs. It cannot cure what weighs on your heart. That needs a different remedy.

zh_CN: 前些天你来看病，你前脚刚走，王公子就来这问你的病情，很是担心你。
en: When you left after your last visit, Young Master Wang came to ask about your health. He was terribly worried.

zh_CN: 唉，我们这行当是做不长久的，只盼着有个如意的郎君，趁着年轻嫁入好人家。
en: Women in my profession cannot work forever. We hope to find a kind husband and marry into a good family while we are still young.

zh_CN: 王郎待我真心诚意，我俩满心欢喜想着赎身之后拜堂成亲，可谁曾想干娘竟如此对我…
en: Wang truly loves me. We dreamed of buying my freedom and marrying, but I never imagined my foster mother would treat me this way…

zh_CN: 我有一计，可使你二人有情人终成眷属。
en: I have an idea that may help the two of you marry.

zh_CN: 少夫人你有什么主意呀？快说快说！
en: Young mistress, what is it? Tell us!

zh_CN: 明日你让郭妈妈来一趟，如此这般….
en: Ask Madam Guo to come here tomorrow. Here is what we shall do…

zh_CN: 吴芷兰和众人说出了自己的主意
en: Wu Zhilan explained her plan to everyone.

zh_CN: 先生若是能帮我们渡此难关，便是再造父母。
en: If you can see us through this, we will owe you as much as we owe our own parents.

zh_CN: 李大夫，你叫我来是什么事儿啊？
en: Doctor Li, why did you ask me to come?

zh_CN: 昨日经我仔细检查，谢姑娘的病乃是肺痨，此病只能缓解，不能根治，而且身边之人都有可能沾染。
en: After a careful examination yesterday, I found that Miss Xie has consumption of the lungs. We can ease it, but not cure it, and people close to her may catch it.
What? What am I to do?

zh_CN: 您还是早做打算，给女儿寻觅个好归宿吧。
en: You had best make arrangements soon and find your daughter a good home.

zh_CN: (若是这样，不如趁那小子不知情，便宜与了他去….)
en: (In that case, I should let that young man have her cheaply before he finds out…)

zh_CN: 不对，我需要好好想想这是什么病，该开什么方。
en: No, that is not right. I need to think carefully about the illness and the proper prescription.
My benefactor! I have come to pay my respects.

zh_CN: 是你啊，快请起。你和谢姑娘怎么样了？
en: It is you. Please, get up. How are you and Miss Xie?

zh_CN: 承蒙恩公出手相助，我二人已结为夫妻，在城外安顿下来，今日特来拜谢。
en: Thanks to your help, we are married and have settled outside the city. We came today to thank you.

zh_CN: 听闻恩公酷好青囊之书，先父也是一生行医，家中有不少先父留下的笔记心得，今日便赠予恩公。
en: I hear you are devoted to medical books. My late father practiced medicine all his life and left many notes. I would like you to have them.

zh_CN: 哎呀，这可太好了，真是求之不得啊。
en: That is wonderful! I could ask for nothing better.

zh_CN: 阿弥陀佛，贫僧法号性空，《中论》曰："众因缘生法，我说即是空，亦为是假名，亦是中道义。"正所谓缘起性空是也。
en: Amitabha Buddha. My Dharma name is Xingkong. The Treatise on the Middle Way says: “Whatever arises through causes and conditions, I call emptiness. It is also a provisional name and the meaning of the Middle Way.” Such is the emptiness of dependent arising.

zh_CN: 师父请坐，今日来小馆是？(这和尚身上好大的酒味啊...)
en: Please, sit down, Master. What brings you to my clinic today? (He smells strongly of wine…)

zh_CN: 最近身体不太舒服，老是耳鸣头晕，请大夫给贫僧看看。
en: I have not felt well lately. My ears ring and I often feel dizzy. Would you examine me, Doctor?

zh_CN: 师父所患的乃是肾精不足之症，嗯…是房事过劳所致…
en: You have a deficiency of kidney essence. Hmm… caused by excessive sexual activity…

zh_CN: 哎哟，施主啊，这可不敢乱说啊，我可是出家人啊，怎么会干那种事呢。
en: My good man, you must not say such things! I am a monk. How could I do that?

zh_CN: 一定是我晚上念经太过用功，着凉了。
en: It must be that I caught a chill while reciting sutras late at night.

zh_CN: 是是是，师父说得对，也不是没有这个可能。
en: Of course, Master. That is possible too.

zh_CN: 嗯，可别到处乱说啊，这钱你拿着吧，这小郎中真是…
en: Yes. Do not spread any rumors. Here, take this money. What a young doctor you are…

zh_CN: 哇，这就是传说中的花和尚吗？
en: Wow. Is that what they call a worldly monk?

zh_CN: 他是花和尚，你是花痴，正好凑一对儿。
en: He is a monk with a wandering eye, and you are lovestruck. You would make a fine pair.

zh_CN: 虽然这不是个正经和尚，但还是得好好想想他得的是什么病。
en: He may not be a model monk, but I still need to diagnose his illness properly.

zh_CN: 少掌柜的，少夫人在屋里晕倒了，您快来看看啊！
en: Young master! The young mistress has fainted in her room! Please come quickly!

zh_CN: 相公，我最近头晕目眩，时不时的还恶心想吐，不知是怎么了…
en: Husband, I have been dizzy lately, and sometimes I feel sick to my stomach. I do not know what is wrong…

zh_CN: 夫人一定是操持家务太过劳累，我给你把把脉。
en: You must be exhausted from running the household. Let me take your pulse.

zh_CN: 呜呜呜，少夫人到底是得了什么病啊。
en: Oh no… What illness does the young mistress have?
Zhilan… We are going to have a child…

zh_CN: 真的吗！哎呀，太好了，是男孩儿女孩儿？
en: Really? Oh, that is wonderful! A boy or a girl?

zh_CN: 现在还看不出来，男孩儿女孩儿都一样，我们要当爹当娘了。
en: It is too early to tell. Boy or girl, it does not matter. We are going to be parents.

zh_CN: 哇，恭喜恭喜，真是菩萨保佑，我去把这喜事告诉老爷去！
en: Congratulations! The Bodhisattva has blessed us! I am going to tell the master the good news!

zh_CN: 不对不对，我在干什么呀，冷静冷静，再好好想想。
en: No, no. What am I doing? Calm down and think again.

zh_CN: 今天是上元佳节，咱们全家去城里逛逛，听说今年的灯节格外热闹。
en: It is the Lantern Festival today. Let us all go into town. I hear this year's celebrations are especially lively.
Wow, so many people! It is so lively!

zh_CN: 看你那没见过世面的样子。
en: You act as if you have never been out before.

zh_CN: 那边好像有唱戏的，咱们去那边看看。
en: There seems to be a play over there. Let us go and watch.

zh_CN: 夫人，那边有座桥，咱们去走百病！
en: Dear, there is a bridge over there. Let us cross it to ward off illness!

zh_CN: 走，今夜走三桥，一年无灾病。
en: Yes! Cross three bridges tonight, and we will be free of sickness all year.

zh_CN: 儿子啊，你和芷兰准备啥时候要孩子啊？
en: Son, when are you and Zhilan going to have a child?
Oh, Father, please do not worry about that.

zh_CN: 你们俩一会儿去南门摸摸福气去，听说可灵了。
en: You two should go to the south gate and touch the lucky charm. I hear it really works.

zh_CN: 别说了爹，咱们看戏去吧。
en: Please, Father. Let us watch the play.

zh_CN: 老爷，那边儿在唱紫钗记呢。
en: Master, they are performing The Purple Hairpin over there.

zh_CN: 谢皇恩灯华月华，谢天恩春华岁华，遍写着国泰民安天下，遨头去唱声哗。好灯也，说灯花南天门最佳，香车隘挑笼绛纱，喝道转身停马，尘影里看谁家。
en: We thank the emperor for lantern light and moonlight; we thank Heaven for springtime and the turning year. Peace fills the realm. Hear the revelers sing! What splendid lanterns! The finest shine at the southern gate. Carriages crowd beneath red silk lanterns. The escort calls for a halt, and through the dusty shadows we wonder who has come.
Husband, let us go solve the lantern riddles!

zh_CN: 这么多灯谜，"一点一横长，一撇到南洋，南阳有个人，只有一寸长"，打一个字…
en: There are so many! “A dot above a long stroke, a slant toward the south; a person in Nanyang, with an inch below.” Guess the Chinese character…
You are clever as ever, my dear. Ha, ha!

zh_CN: 你看这个，"大雪压青松"，打一味药材。
en: Look at this one: “Heavy snow presses on a green pine.” Name a medicinal herb.
I know this one. It is honeysuckle.

zh_CN: 东璧，芷兰，咱们去小摊儿坐会儿吃点元宵。
en: Dongbi, Zhilan, let us sit at a stall and have some sweet rice balls.

zh_CN: 干了一年坐堂医，感觉怎么样，和你之前想的一样吗？
en: You have spent a year treating patients at the clinic. How does it feel? Is it what you expected?

zh_CN: 我倒是挺喜欢这一行，只是赚不到什么钱，苦了您和芷兰了…
en: I do enjoy the work. I only wish it earned more. You and Zhilan have had to make sacrifices because of me…

zh_CN: 只要咱们一家人能一起平平安安的过日子，我就知足了，要那么多钱做什么。
en: As long as our family can live safely together, I have all I need. What would we do with more money?

zh_CN: 是啊，一家人平平安安就好啊。
en: Yes. Being together and well is enough.

zh_CN: 好了，不早了，咱们该回家了。
en: It is getting late. We should go home.

zh_CN: 大夫啊，您快给看看吧，这孩子整日目光呆滞，叫他也不应，就在那自言自语，嘴里不知道嘟囔这什么，怪邪乎的…
en: Doctor, please look at my son. He stares into space all day and does not answer when spoken to. He mutters to himself. It is downright uncanny…
Do not worry. Sit down and let me examine him.

zh_CN: 公子所患的是痰迷心窍之症，开副涤痰汤调理一下。
en: Your son has phlegm clouding the mind. I will prescribe Phlegm-Expelling Decoction to help him recover.

zh_CN: 好好的怎么就得了这怪病呢？
en: How did he suddenly develop such a strange illness?

zh_CN: 是不是读书压力太大了呀？
en: Could the pressure of studying be too much for him?

zh_CN: 他就一门心思读书，其他的什么都不用他管，能有什么压力？
en: All he does is study. We take care of everything else. What pressure could he have?

zh_CN: 再说了天下那么多读书人，怎么就他得了这怪病？
en: Besides, there are countless scholars in the world. Why would only he fall ill like this?

zh_CN: 很多人表面上看着正常，其实都病得不轻呢。
en: Many people seem perfectly well on the outside when they are suffering deeply within.

zh_CN: 胡扯，我看你就是没病说成有病，骗病人买药赚钱
en: Nonsense! You call him sick when he is not, just to sell him medicine.

zh_CN: 咱们家可是花了好多钱，把地都卖了供你读书，就只望着你能出人头地，光宗耀祖。可你怎么就这么不争气呢？
en: We spent so much on your education that we even sold our land! All we ask is that you succeed and bring honor to the family. Why can you not live up to that?

zh_CN: 这位仁兄，我也是读过书考过科举的，读书人其实也是有很多难处的。
en: Sir, I too studied and sat the imperial examinations. Scholars face many hardships of their own.

zh_CN: 难？还能有我赚钱养家糊口难？天底下还能有比我们做父母更难的？
en: Hardships? Are they harder than earning enough to feed a family? Who has it harder than us parents?

zh_CN: 再过半年可就要考试了，你这次无论如何也要给我好好考。
en: The examinations are only six months away. You must do well this time, whatever it takes.

zh_CN: 不对，我需要好好想想这是什么病，该开什么方。
en: No, that is not right. I need to think carefully about the illness and the proper prescription.
